 ABOUT CAPE COD CANNABIS
 
 
 
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary Near Me in Wellfleet, MA 
 Looking for the best Cape Cod dispensary near me? Visit Cape Cod Cannabis , located at 1446 US-6, Wellfleet, MA 02667, just minutes from downtown Wellfleet and right off Route 6 in South Wellfleet’s shopping plaza. We proudly serve both local Cape Cod residents and seasonal visitors with a wide selection of premium cannabis products , at the best prices on Cape Cod, knowledgeable and friendly service… and a cool vibe!

 Whether you’re new to cannabis or a seasoned consumer, our knowledgeable team is here to help you choose the right product for your needs.
 
 Explore our robust menu, including:

 We’re committed to making your experience easy, informative, and enjoyable, with no pressure, just helpful advice from a local team that knows cannabis.
 
 A Convenient Stop for Cape Cod Locals and Visitors 
 Conveniently located on Route 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza, Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary is an easy stop for anyone traveling to or from Provincetown, Eastham, Wellfleet, Truro, Orleans, Brewster, Hyannis and communities throughout Cape Cod. It’s a beautiful drive and…it’s worth the trip!
 
 Whether you’re exploring the Cape’s beaches, biking the Rail Trail, or heading back from a day at the National Seashore, our dispensary is a quick and convenient stop for all your cannabis needs. If you’re searching for weed near me on Cape Cod , our Wellfleet dispensary is conveniently located directly on Route 6 with easy access, free parking and online ordering for pickup.
 
 Why Cape Cod Cannabis? 
 Customers searching for “weed near me,” “dispensary near me,” “Cape Cod cannabis store,” or a recreational dispensary in Wellfleet choose Cape Cod Cannabis for:

 Whether you’re exploring different cannabis products, consumption methods, or simply looking to try something new, we’ve got something for everyone, backed by customer-first service and deep local knowledge .

 Cape Cod Cannabis is more than a Wellfleet dispensary…we’re a destination. Locals and visitors alike rely on us for quality cannabis, honest guidance, and a smooth shopping experience. Stop by today and see why we’re consistently rated as the best dispensary in Wellfleet, MA , and one of the top cannabis spots on Cape Cod.
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary…Always worth the trip! 

 

 
 
 
 CLICK TO VIEW FAQs
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Where is Cape Cod Cannabis located? 
 Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary is located at 1446 US-6, Wellfleet, MA 02667 . We’re conveniently located along Route 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza, designed like a rest stop, for easy entry and exit with plenty of free parking, includes a bakery, liquor store, and U.S. Post Office for your convenience. Click here for directions . 
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis is a licensed adult-use recreational dispensary serving residents and visitors alike in Barnstable , Bourne , Brewster , Chatham , Dennis , Eastham , Falmouth , Harwich , Hyannis , Mashpee , Orleans , Provincetown , Sandwich , Truro , Wellfleet , Yarmouth and beyond. 

 
 
 
 
 
 Where can I find weed near me on Cape Cod? 
 If you’re searching for weed near me on Cape Cod , Cape Cod Cannabis is an adult-use recreational dispensary located at 1446 US-6 in Wellfleet, Massachusetts , in the South Wellfleet area of the Outer Cape. We’re open daily and offer a wide selection of recreational cannabis products. Customers 21+ can shop in-store or order online for convenient pickup with valid ID.

 
 
 
 
 
 What is the legal age to purchase cannabis in Massachusetts? 
 We welcome anyone 21 years of age or older with a valid Government ID (e.g., Drivers License, Passport, etc.) to verify your age upon entry. Unfortunately, we cannot accept expired MA ID’s unless, when already renewed, you bring the expired MA ID with the actual MA RMV documentation for the renewal.
 
 Unfortunately, we cannot accept any out-of-state or International ID’s that are expired. 
 
 Note : We respect if you are wearing a mask when you enter but please know that, per regulations, we have to properly identify everyone who enters. You will be asked to momentarily remove (or lower) your mask for identification purposes. We thank you for your cooperation and understanding. 

 
 
 
 
 
 What should I expect when visiting a dispensary for the first time? 
 If it’s your first time visiting a dispensary in Massachusetts, the process is simple and welcoming. When you arrive, you’ll be asked to show a valid government-issued ID to confirm you are 21 or older. After check-in, you can browse the menu or speak with a knowledgeable staff member (often called a budtender) who can help you choose products based on your preferences and experience level.
 
 At Cape Cod Cannabis, you’ll find a variety of options including flower , pre-rolls , edibles , vapes , tinctures , topicals , CBD and concentrates . Our budtenders are here to answer questions and make recommendations, whether you’re looking to relax, sleep better, or try cannabis for the first time. Once you’ve made your selection, you’ll proceed to checkout—we accept cash and debit payment options. We also have an on-site ATM for your convenience.
 
 Overall, expect a safe, regulated, and educational experience designed to help you feel comfortable and informed…and NOT rushed.
 
 We also offer an online assistant (bottom left side of the website) to ask questions and lead you in the right direction. Please give us a call at (774) 383-3133 if you have further questions.

 
 
 
 
 
 What do customers say about Cape Cod Cannabis? 
 
 2026 Cape Cod Choice Awards: Best CBD Store Winner | Top 3 Best Cannabis Dispensary 
 Customers frequently mention our knowledgeable and friendly team, wide cannabis selection, personalized service, welcoming atmosphere, convenient Route 6 location, and overall dispensary experience. Read our recent customer reviews to see feedback directly from customers.

 
 
 
 
 
 Can I leave a review for Cape Cod Cannabis? 
 Yes. Visit our Leave Your Review page to share your experience on Google or Yelp.

 
 
 
 
 
 What are the operating hours for Cape Cod Cannabis? 
 We’re open 7 days a week. Please check our hours for the most up-to-date hours, including holiday schedules.

 
 
 
 
 
 What cannabis products do you carry? 
 Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary in Wellfleet offers the largest selection of quality flower , pre-rolls , seeds , edibles , vapes , concentrates , syrups / tinctures , CBD , topicals , pet drops and more at the BEST prices on Cape Cod…something for every preference and experience level. Always worth the trip! 

 
 
 
 
 
 Is there a limit to how much cannabis I can buy? 
 Yes. As of April 19, 2026 , Massachusetts law allows you to purchase up to 2 ounces of flower (Recreational) or its equivalent in other cannabis products per day.
 
 Click here to visit our “Understanding the Daily Purchase Limit in MA” page for more information and to calculate your daily purchase.
 
 Recreational = 56 grams (flower) a day is the legal MA limit, which can constitute: 
 
 • Flower : Up to 56 grams (2 ounces).
 • Edibles : A total of 10 00mg THC , which is roughly 10 packs of 20 servings , each serving containing 5mg of THC .
 • Concentrates : Up to 10 grams of cannabis concentrates, such as wax, shatter, or live resin (equivalent to 10 x 1g or 20 x 0.5g packages).
 • Tinctures : A total of 10000mg = approximately 10 x 1000mg bottles , depending on the product’s potency and total THC content.
 • Pre-roll Joints : 56 pre-roll joints , assuming each joint contains roughly 1 gram of flower .
 • Vape Cartridges : Up to 20 x 0.5g cartridges or 10 x 1g cartridges/disposables .
 
 CBD = No Limit 
 Topicals = No Limit 
 Accessories = No Limit 

 
 
 
 
 
 Are your cannabis products tested for safety and quality? 
 Yes. Cannabis products sold at Cape Cod Cannabis are required to meet Massachusetts testing and labeling requirements before being offered for retail sale.

 
 
 
 
 
 What payment methods are accepted? 
 We accept cash, debit cards and CanPay . A regular ATM is also located on-site for your convenience.
 
 Note : ATM and Debit transactions will incur a small third-party merchant fee. 

 
 
 
 
 
 Do you offer online ordering or pre-orders? 
 Yes! Browse our full menu online or our Daily Offers page and place a pre-order for quick and easy pickup in-store.
 
 Once you finalize your order, it will be filled within 15 minutes and you will be able to pick it up at the store. Changes to pre-orders can be made during checkout at the store.
 
 PLEASE double check your phone number when entering your pre-order. 
 
 We will not keep orders placed, past our store closing, the day of when the order was placed.

 
 
 
 
 
 What should I know about cannabis? 
 For a quick overview of the different types of cannabis products, terpenes, cannabinoids, strains and more please visit Intro to Cannabis 101 .

 
 
 
 
 
 Do you offer a Loyalty Program? 
 Yes! We do offer a FREE Loyalty VIP Program where you can accumulate points that will be generated automatically and tracked for you for redemption.
 
 NOTE : Per MA Cannabis Control Commission regulations, Loyalty Points CANNOT be used for cannabis products . 
 
 Currently, y ou CAN use your Loyalty Points toward Cape Cod Cannabis CBD, Accessories or Merch only. 
 
 As soon as the CCC ( Cannabis Control Commission ) will approve or will remove the limitations on the promotions, you will be able to use these points toward all Cape Cod Cannabis products. That way you will not miss out on any points you could have accumulated if there were no limitations to begin with. In the meantime, you will get access to the VIP program.
 
 Not a Loyalty Program VIP member? JOIN FOR FREE IN-STORE TODAY! 
 
 Already a Loyalty Program VIP member? Click here to Shop your Loyalty VIP Points. 

 
 
 
 
 
 What is your Return Policy? 
 Cape Cod Cannabis is committed to customer satisfaction when it comes to the products we sell.
 
 RETURN POLICY 
 Please visit our Return Policy page for more information.
 
 CONTACT US 
 If you have any questions regarding our Return Policy please contact us or call (774) 383-3133.

 
 
 
 
 
 What is your Privacy Policy? 
 PRIVACY POLICY 
 Please visit our Privacy Policy page for more information.
 
 CONTACT US 
 If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy please contact us or call us at (774) 383-3133.

 
 
 
 
 
 Do you ship your Apparel? 
 Yes! Our apparel, hats, beanies, sweatshirts, joggers and more can be shipped to you (within the United States only) via USPS Priority. Please visit our online store Blue Tail Apparel & Merch @ www.BlueTail.cc for convenient, safe and easy shopping and we will ship your order to you!
 
 Of course, you can always pre-order Cape Cod Cannabis apparel , accessories and merch for local pickup.
 
 * Please note : Loyalty Points do not apply for purchases on BlueTail.cc at this time. 
 
 In-store or pre-order (non-cannabis) purchases on CapeCodCannabis.com are applicable using your Loyalty Points.

 250 Years of America: Celebrating Independence, Community, and the Spirit of Cape Cod

 
 
 
 
 
 June 19, 2026 
 
 

 Home / Cape Cod Lifestyle / 250 Years of America: Celebrating Independence, Community, and the Spirit of Cape Cod 
 

 250 Years of America: Celebrating Independence, Community, and the Spirit of Cape Cod 
 
 
 
 Honoring 250 Years of American Independence 
 In 2026, the United States marks an extraordinary milestone: 250 years since the signing of the Declaration of Independence .
 
 From the first shots of the American Revolution to the innovation and opportunity that continue to define our nation today, America’s 250th anniversary is a celebration of freedom, perseverance, community, and the shared values that have shaped generations.
 
 At Cape Cod Cannabis , we are proud to join our fellow Americans in commemorating this historic occasion while reflecting on the unique role Cape Cod has played throughout our nation’s story. As we celebrate America 250 , we honor the past, appreciate the present, and look forward to the future.
 
 Cape Cod’s Place in American History 
 Few places embody the spirit of America quite like Cape Cod.
 
 Long before it became one of the country’s most beloved destinations, Cape Cod served as an important part of early American history. From maritime trade and fishing communities to military service and coastal defense, the Cape has long contributed to the growth and success of the nation. The lighthouses that dot our coastline stand as symbols of resilience and guidance. The harbors, villages, and historic landmarks throughout Cape Cod remind us of the generations who worked hard, served their communities, and helped build the America we know today.
 
 As visitors gather throughout 2026 to celebrate America’s semiquincentennial, Cape Cod provides a perfect backdrop for reflection, appreciation, and community.
 
 
 
 
 
 Honoring Those Who Came Before Us 
 The 250th anniversary is about more than a date on a calendar. It is an opportunity to recognize the sacrifices and contributions of those who came before us. From the Revolutionary War and the founding generation to the service members who defended freedom throughout American history, every generation has played a role in shaping our nation.
 
 We honor: 
 The visionaries who established a new nation in 1776 
 The military personnel who served throughout our history 
 The workers, entrepreneurs, and innovators who built our economy 
 The communities that continue to strengthen America every day 
 
 Their dedication and perseverance created opportunities that continue to benefit future generations.
 
 Celebrating American Innovation 
 America’s story is also one of innovation.
 
 Over the past 250 years, the United States has led advancements in science, technology, medicine, agriculture, transportation, and exploration. From the first ships that sailed New England waters to modern achievements in space exploration, Americans have consistently pushed boundaries and embraced new ideas.
 
 The cannabis industry itself represents part of this evolving story.
 
 Through responsible regulation, scientific research, and consumer education, the industry continues to grow while creating jobs, supporting local economies, and providing access to regulated products for adult consumers.
 
 The Importance of Community 
 One of the greatest strengths of America has always been its communities. Across the country, local businesses, nonprofits, artists, educators, and community leaders help create the places we call home. Here on Cape Cod, that spirit is visible every day. Whether supporting local events, preserving natural resources, celebrating local artists, or welcoming visitors from around the world, Cape Cod thrives because of the people who invest their time, energy, and passion into the community.
 
 At Cape Cod Cannabis, we are proud to be part of that tradition. As a locally rooted business in Wellfleet, we believe that supporting our community is just as important as serving our customers.
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis and the Future of Cape Cod 
 As America celebrates 250 years, Cape Cod Cannabis remains committed to the values that matter most:
 
 Education 
 Helping customers make informed decisions through honest and approachable cannabis education .
 
 Quality 
 Providing carefully selected cannabis products from trusted Massachusetts cultivators and manufacturers.
 
 Community 
 Supporting local organizations, artists, and initiatives that strengthen Cape Cod.
 
 Service 
 Creating a welcoming environment where every customer feels comfortable and respected. These values guide everything we do and reflect the same spirit of opportunity and progress that has defined America for generations.
 
 Celebrating America 250 on Cape Cod 
 Throughout 2026, communities across Cape Cod will participate in celebrations, commemorations, and events honoring America’s 250th anniversary. From historic sites and local festivals to waterfront gatherings and community celebrations, there will be countless opportunities to reflect on our shared history and enjoy time with family and friends. Whether you are a year-round resident or visiting Cape Cod during this historic year, we encourage you to take a moment to appreciate the beauty, history, and community that make this region so special.
 
 Looking Ahead to the Next 250 Years 
 America’s story continues to evolve. While the past 250 years have been remarkable, the future will be shaped by the choices, innovations, and communities of today. As we celebrate this milestone, we remain optimistic about what lies ahead. By supporting local businesses, strengthening our communities, preserving our natural resources, and investing in future generations, we can help ensure that the next chapter of American history is just as inspiring as the first.
 
 Proudly Serving Cape Cod 
 At Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet , we are honored to serve residents and visitors throughout Wellfleet, Provincetown, Truro, Eastham, Orleans, Brewster, and the entire Cape Cod community. Stop by Cape Cod Cannabis in the Route 6 South Wellfleet shopping plaza too and discover the beauty of charm of Wellfleet ! 
 
 As America celebrates its 250th anniversary, Cape Cod remains a place where history, community, and coastal traditions continue to thrive. Whether you’re exploring Wellfleet’s beaches, visiting local attractions, enjoying fresh seafood, or experiencing the natural beauty of the Outer Cape, there has never been a better time to discover what makes Cape Cod such a special part of the American story.
 
 
 Happy 250th Birthday, America. 
 1776 – 2026 
 Proudly Serving Cape Cod. Proudly Celebrating America. 
 
 
 Always worth the trip!

About Cape Cod Cannabis

 Cannabis Dispensary located in Wellfleet, MA

 About Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary Near Me

 
 2026 Cape Cod Choice Awards:
Best CBD Store Winner | Top 3 Best Cannabis Dispensary 

 
 At Cape Cod Cannabis, Wellfleet’s first dispensary, our mission is to cultivate a vibrant and sustainable cannabis community, rooted in the spirit of the Cape, where the beauty of the region is celebrated through responsible and innovative cannabis practices. We are committed to providing our customers with the highest quality cannabis products while promoting education, accessibility, and well-being.
 
 We believe in the power of cannabis to enhance lives and foster a sense of wellness. Our dedicated team is passionate about delivering safe and reliable cannabis products that meet the diverse needs of our community. We are driven by a commitment to quality, transparency, and sustainability in all aspects of our operations.
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary, located in the Rt. 6 shopping plaza in South Wellfleet, offers the largest selection and best prices on Cape Cod. Our product assortment includes flower , pre-rolls , edibles , beverages , vaporizers , tinctures , concentrates , CBD products , topicals , seeds , smoking accessories and branded apparel (need our Apparel shipped to you? Visit www.BlueTail.cc to order) .
 
 Our knowledgeable and friendly staff will ensure that you have a pleasant and informed shopping experience and our security staff ensure convenient and safe parking in our designated spaces during the store’s operating hours.
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet…Always worth the trip! 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 Wellfleet, MA is one of Cape Cod’s most unforgettable destinations, known for its beautiful beaches, fresh seafood, local art galleries, scenic trails, oyster culture, and relaxed Outer Cape atmosphere. From exploring the Cape Cod National Seashore and Wellfleet Harbor to dining at beloved local restaurants and discovering unique shops and cultural attractions, Wellfleet offers an authentic Cape Cod experience unlike anywhere else on the Cape.
 
 Conveniently located on Route 6 in South Wellfleet, Cape Cod Cannabis is the perfect stop along your journey, offering a welcoming environment, knowledgeable staff, easy access, and a carefully curated selection for both locals and visitors exploring the Outer Cape.

 
 
 
 Discover Wellfleet 
 
 

 
 
 
 WHY CAPE COD CANNABIS
 
 
 
 
 ⭐ Serving Cape Cod Since 2021 
 ⭐ 900+ Google Reviews 
 ⭐ 4.9★ Rating 

 
 Trusted by Cape Cod Residents and Visitors Since 2021 
 Choosing a cannabis dispensary is about more than finding the closest location. It’s about finding knowledgeable people, quality products, and a place you can trust.
 
 Since opening in 2021 , Cape Cod Cannabis has proudly served Cape Cod residents and visitors with a commitment to education, exceptional customer service, and responsible cannabis retail. Conveniently located in the Route 6 shopping plaza in South Wellfleet , we welcome customers from Provincetown to Sandwich and beyond, and everywhere in between.
 
 Whether you’re visiting Cape Cod for a weekend getaway or you’re a year-round resident, our goal is simple: provide a welcoming, informative, and comfortable shopping experience while helping every customer make confident, informed cannabis decisions.
 
 Why Trust Cape Cod Cannabis? 
 At Cape Cod Cannabis, trust is earned through consistency, transparency, and a genuine commitment to our customers.
 
 We believe every customer deserves friendly service, knowledgeable guidance, and access to quality recreational cannabis products in a welcoming environment. Whether you’re exploring cannabis for the first time or have years of experience, our team is here to answer your questions, explain your options, and help you find products that best fit your preferences.
 
 Since 2021, we’ve built lasting relationships with thousands of customers by focusing on education before recommendations, honesty before sales, and exceptional service during every visit.
 
 By the Numbers 
 
Established 
 2018 
 
Open Since 
 2021 
 
Google Rating 
 4.9 Stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 
 
Google Reviews 
 900+ 
 
Customers Served 
 Thousands of satisfied customers 
 
Product Categories 
 Flower • Pre-Rolls • Edibles • Vaporizers • Concentrates • Tinctures • Topicals • CBD • Seeds • Accessories • Apparel 
 
Online Ordering 
 Available for pre-ordering 
 
In-Store Pickup 
 Available 
 
Parking 
 Free On-Site Parking 
 
Open 
 Daily, Year-Round 
 
What Our Customers Say 
 Our customers consistently describe their experience at Cape Cod Cannabis as friendly, welcoming, and informative.
 
 Across hundreds of Google reviews, customers frequently mention:
 
 Friendly and welcoming staff
 Knowledgeable product recommendations
 One of Cape Cod’s largest selections of cannabis products
 A comfortable experience for first-time visitors
 Convenient Route 6 location with free parking
 Easy online ordering and in-store pickup
 Professional, educational approach to cannabis
 Great product variety and value
 Helpful guidance without pressure
 A shopping experience that’s always worth the trip
 
 These recurring themes reflect the experience we strive to provide every day.
 
 Education First 
 Responsible and informative education is at the heart of everything we do.
 
 Cannabis affects everyone differently, which is why we believe informed customers make better decisions. Our knowledgeable team takes the time to answer questions, explain products, discuss different consumption methods, and help customers understand the differences between flower, pre-rolls, edibles, vaporizers, concentrates, tinctures, CBD products, seeds, and more. We also offer our Intro to Cannabis 101 page for your reference.
 
 Whether you’re new to cannabis or an experienced consumer, we’re committed to providing clear, honest information so you can shop with confidence.
 
 Serving Cape Cod and beyond… 
 Cape Cod Cannabis proudly serves customers from across Cape Cod and beyond, including:
 
 Provincetown
 Truro
 Wellfleet
 Eastham
 Orleans
 Brewster
 Harwich
 Chatham
 Dennis
 Yarmouth
 Hyannis
 Barnstable
 Mashpee
 Falmouth
 Sandwich
 
 We also welcome thousands of visitors who make Cape Cod Cannabis a stop during their Cape Cod vacation. Conveniently located directly on Route 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza , we’re easy to find with plenty of free parking.
 
 Our Commitment 
 We’re committed to operating responsibly while providing a safe, welcoming, and educational environment for every customer.
 
 Our commitment includes:
 
 Providing quality, licensed recreational cannabis products 
 Helping customers make informed purchasing decisions
 Promoting responsible cannabis consumption
 Supporting our local Cape Cod community
 Maintaining a clean, professional, and welcoming retail environment
 Continuously expanding our knowledge to better serve our customers
 
 Every customer interaction is an opportunity to build trust, answer questions, and provide an exceptional experience.
 
 Why It’s Always Worth the Trip 
 Cape Cod Cannabis has become a trusted destination for both Cape Cod residents and visitors seeking quality recreational cannabis products, knowledgeable guidance, and outstanding customer service.
 
 Whether you’re traveling from a neighboring town or making Cape Cod part of your vacation, we invite you to discover why so many customers continue to choose Cape Cod Cannabis year after year.
 
 From our extensive product selection and friendly team to our convenient South Wellfleet location, we’re committed to providing an experience that’s informative, welcoming, and always worth the trip.
 
 We look forward to welcoming you soon.
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis…Always Worth the Trip. 
 

 

 
 
 
 CLICK HERE TO VIEW FAQs
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Where is Cape Cod Cannabis located? 
 Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary is located at 1446 US-6, Wellfleet, MA 02667 . We’re conveniently located along Route 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza, designed like a rest stop, for easy entry and exit with plenty of free parking, includes a bakery, liquor store, and U.S. Post Office for your convenience. Click here for directions . 
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis is a licensed adult-use recreational dispensary serving residents and visitors alike in Barnstable , Bourne , Brewster , Chatham , Dennis , Eastham , Falmouth , Harwich , Hyannis , Mashpee , Orleans , Provincetown , Sandwich , Truro , Wellfleet , Yarmouth and beyond. 

 
 
 
 
 
 Where can I find weed near me on Cape Cod? 
 If you’re searching for weed near me on Cape Cod , Cape Cod Cannabis is an adult-use recreational dispensary located at 1446 US-6 in Wellfleet, Massachusetts , in the South Wellfleet area of the Outer Cape. We’re open daily and offer a wide selection of recreational cannabis products. Customers 21+ can shop in-store or order online for convenient pickup with valid ID.

 
 
 
 
 
 What is the legal age to purchase cannabis in Massachusetts? 
 We welcome anyone 21 years of age or older with a valid Government ID (e.g., Drivers License, Passport, etc.) to verify your age upon entry. Unfortunately, we cannot accept expired MA ID’s unless, when already renewed, you bring the expired MA ID with the actual MA RMV documentation for the renewal.
 
 Unfortunately, we cannot accept any out-of-state or International ID’s that are expired. 
 
 Note : We respect if you are wearing a mask when you enter but please know that, per regulations, we have to properly identify everyone who enters. You will be asked to momentarily remove (or lower) your mask for identification purposes. We thank you for your cooperation and understanding. 

 
 
 
 
 
 What should I expect when visiting a dispensary for the first time? 
 If it’s your first time visiting a dispensary in Massachusetts, the process is simple and welcoming. When you arrive, you’ll be asked to show a valid government-issued ID to confirm you are 21 or older. After check-in, you can browse the menu or speak with a knowledgeable staff member (often called a budtender) who can help you choose products based on your preferences and experience level.
 
 At Cape Cod Cannabis, you’ll find a variety of options including flower , pre-rolls , edibles , vapes , tinctures , topicals , CBD and concentrates . Our budtenders are here to answer questions and make recommendations, whether you’re looking to relax, sleep better, or try cannabis for the first time. Once you’ve made your selection, you’ll proceed to checkout—we accept cash and debit payment options. We also have an on-site ATM for your convenience.
 
 Overall, expect a safe, regulated, and educational experience designed to help you feel comfortable and informed…and NOT rushed.
 
 We also offer an online assistant (bottom left side of the website) to ask questions and lead you in the right direction. Please give us a call at (774) 383-3133 if you have further questions.

 
 
 
 
 
 What do customers say about Cape Cod Cannabis? 
 
 2026 Cape Cod Choice Awards: Best CBD Store Winner | Top 3 Best Cannabis Dispensary 
 Customers frequently mention our knowledgeable and friendly team, wide cannabis selection, personalized service, welcoming atmosphere, convenient Route 6 location, and overall dispensary experience. Read our recent customer reviews to see feedback directly from customers.

 
 
 
 
 
 Can I leave a review for Cape Cod Cannabis? 
 Yes. Visit our Leave Your Review page to share your experience on Google or Yelp.

 
 
 
 
 
 What are the operating hours for Cape Cod Cannabis? 
 We’re open 7 days a week. Please check our hours for the most up-to-date hours, including holiday schedules.

 
 
 
 
 
 What cannabis products do you carry? 
 Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary in Wellfleet offers the largest selection of quality flower , pre-rolls , seeds , edibles , vapes , concentrates , syrups / tinctures , CBD , topicals , pet drops and more at the BEST prices on Cape Cod…something for every preference and experience level. Always worth the trip! 

 
 
 
 
 
 Is there a limit to how much cannabis I can buy? 
 Yes. As of April 19, 2026 , Massachusetts law allows you to purchase up to 2 ounces of flower (Recreational) or its equivalent in other cannabis products per day.
 
 Click here to visit our “Understanding the Daily Purchase Limit in MA” page for more information and to calculate your daily purchase.
 
 Recreational = 56 grams (flower) a day is the legal MA limit, which can constitute: 
 
 • Flower : Up to 56 grams (2 ounces).
 • Edibles : A total of 10 00mg THC , which is roughly 10 packs of 20 servings , each serving containing 5mg of THC .
 • Concentrates : Up to 10 grams of cannabis concentrates, such as wax, shatter, or live resin (equivalent to 10 x 1g or 20 x 0.5g packages).
 • Tinctures : A total of 10000mg = approximately 10 x 1000mg bottles , depending on the product’s potency and total THC content.
 • Pre-roll Joints : 56 pre-roll joints , assuming each joint contains roughly 1 gram of flower .
 • Vape Cartridges : Up to 20 x 0.5g cartridges or 10 x 1g cartridges/disposables .
 
 CBD = No Limit 
 Topicals = No Limit 
 Accessories = No Limit 

 
 
 
 
 
 Are your cannabis products tested for safety and quality? 
 Yes. Cannabis products sold at Cape Cod Cannabis are required to meet Massachusetts testing and labeling requirements before being offered for retail sale.

 
 
 
 
 
 What payment methods are accepted? 
 We accept cash, debit cards and CanPay . A regular ATM is also located on-site for your convenience.
 
 Note : ATM and Debit transactions will incur a small third-party merchant fee. 

 
 
 
 
 
 Do you offer online ordering or pre-orders? 
 Yes! Browse our full menu online or our Daily Offers page and place a pre-order for quick and easy pickup in-store.
 
 Once you finalize your order, it will be filled within 15 minutes and you will be able to pick it up at the store. Changes to pre-orders can be made during checkout at the store.
 
 PLEASE double check your phone number when entering your pre-order. 
 
 We will not keep orders placed, past our store closing, the day of when the order was placed.

 
 
 
 
 
 What should I know about cannabis? 
 For a quick overview of the different types of cannabis products, terpenes, cannabinoids, strains and more please visit Intro to Cannabis 101 .

 
 
 
 
 
 Do you offer a Loyalty Program? 
 Yes! We do offer a FREE Loyalty VIP Program where you can accumulate points that will be generated automatically and tracked for you for redemption.
 
 NOTE : Per MA Cannabis Control Commission regulations, Loyalty Points CANNOT be used for cannabis products . 
 
 Currently, y ou CAN use your Loyalty Points toward Cape Cod Cannabis CBD, Accessories or Merch only. 
 
 As soon as the CCC ( Cannabis Control Commission ) will approve or will remove the limitations on the promotions, you will be able to use these points toward all Cape Cod Cannabis products. That way you will not miss out on any points you could have accumulated if there were no limitations to begin with. In the meantime, you will get access to the VIP program.
 
 Not a Loyalty Program VIP member? JOIN FOR FREE IN-STORE TODAY! 
 
 Already a Loyalty Program VIP member? Click here to Shop your Loyalty VIP Points. 

 
 
 
 
 
 What is your Return Policy? 
 Cape Cod Cannabis is committed to customer satisfaction when it comes to the products we sell.
 
 RETURN POLICY 
 Please visit our Return Policy page for more information.
 
 CONTACT US 
 If you have any questions regarding our Return Policy please contact us or call (774) 383-3133.

 
 
 
 
 
 What is your Privacy Policy? 
 PRIVACY POLICY 
 Please visit our Privacy Policy page for more information.
 
 CONTACT US 
 If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy please contact us or call us at (774) 383-3133.

 
 
 
 
 
 Do you ship your Apparel? 
 Yes! Our apparel, hats, beanies, sweatshirts, joggers and more can be shipped to you (within the United States only) via USPS Priority. Please visit our online store Blue Tail Apparel & Merch @ www.BlueTail.cc for convenient, safe and easy shopping and we will ship your order to you!
 
 Of course, you can always pre-order Cape Cod Cannabis apparel , accessories and merch for local pickup.
 
 * Please note : Loyalty Points do not apply for purchases on BlueTail.cc at this time. 
 
 In-store or pre-order (non-cannabis) purchases on CapeCodCannabis.com are applicable using your Loyalty Points. 

 

 

 
 

 

 Google Reviews

 Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary , located in the Rt. 6 shopping plaza in South Wellfleet , offers the largest selection of quality products at the best prices and proudly serves Cape Cod community residents and visitors alike, handling all your cannabis needs. We have 900+ reviews with a 4.9 / 5.0 star rating…see what your neighbors are saying about their experience .

 Trusted by Cape Cod residents and visitors since 2021.

 🅿️ Easy Parking

 For your convenience, we have 26 dedicated parking spaces. Several municipal parking spaces are located in the shopping plaza at no charge as well. Click here for directions .

 An Introduction to Cannabinoids

 
 
 
 
 
 May 1, 2025 
 
 

 Home / Start Here / An Introduction to Cannabinoids 
 

 An Introduction to Cannabinoids: The Natural Compounds Behind Cannabis Wellness 
 If you’ve ever wondered what actually gives cannabis its effects—whether you’re feeling mellow, pain-free, clear-headed, or just deeply relaxed—the answer lies in something called cannabinoids . These natural compounds are the real workhorses of the cannabis plant, and they’re responsible for how your body and mind respond after you consume it.
 
 Cannabinoids are chemical compounds found in cannabis that interact with your body’s endocannabinoid system (ECS) —a built-in network that helps regulate mood, sleep, appetite, pain, immune function, and more. Your body actually produces its own cannabinoids (called endocannabinoids), and the ones in cannabis (called phytocannabinoids) work in similar ways to help bring your system back into balance.
 
 The most well-known cannabinoids are THC and CBD , but the plant actually contains over 100 others—each offering its own unique set of effects. THC, or tetrahydrocannabinol, is the one most people associate with the euphoric “high” of cannabis. But it’s not just about the buzz; THC is also a powerful compound for managing pain, improving sleep, and easing anxiety (especially in low to moderate doses). On the other hand, CBD , or cannabidiol, doesn’t get you high at all. Instead, it works behind the scenes to reduce inflammation, calm the nervous system, and help you feel more grounded and focused. It’s a favorite among people looking for relief without the intoxication.
 
 Beyond THC and CBD, lesser-known cannabinoids like CBG (cannabigerol) and CBN (cannabinol) are gaining popularity too. CBG is often called the “mother cannabinoid” because it’s the compound from which others develop. It’s being studied for its potential to support focus, gut health, and immune response. CBN, on the other hand, is a go-to for sleep—offering gentle, sedating effects that can help you wind down without feeling groggy the next day.
 
 What’s fascinating about cannabinoids is how they work together. This is known as the entourage effect —a kind of chemical teamwork between cannabinoids and other plant compounds like terpenes (the aromatic oils in cannabis) . When taken together, they can enhance each other’s benefits and create a more balanced, effective experience. That’s why many people opt for full-spectrum products , which preserve the full array of cannabinoids and terpenes found in the plant.
 
 There’s also no shortage of ways to explore cannabinoids. If you prefer something fast-acting, flower and vapes deliver immediate effects and allow you to adjust your dose easily. Tinctures offer discreet, under-the-tongue use with effects that last longer, while edibles like gummies or chocolates can take a bit longer to kick in—but provide longer, more sustained relief. Topicals are great if you’re looking for localized relief from joint or muscle pain, and concentrates —high-potency extracts like wax or live resin—are ideal for more experienced users looking for powerful effects in small amounts. For those who want to skip THC entirely, CBD-only products are available in oils, capsules, balms, and more—offering natural relief without the high.
 
 Whether you’re just beginning your cannabis journey or looking to better understand the plant you already love, getting to know cannabinoids is a great place to start. These compounds are what make cannabis so effective—and so versatile. From better sleep and reduced stress to pain relief and overall wellness, cannabinoids are helping people feel better, naturally.
 
 For more information please visit our Terpene & Cannabinoid Guide .

 An Introduction to Terpenes

 
 
 
 
 
 May 1, 2025 
 
 

 Home / Start Here / An Introduction to Terpenes 
 

 An Introduction to Terpenes: What They Are and Why They Matter 
 When shopping for cannabis at our Wellfleet dispensary, you’ve probably noticed product descriptions mentioning words like “myrcene,” “limonene,” or “caryophyllene.” These aren’t just fancy terms—they’re terpenes , and they play a major role in how cannabis affects your mind and body.
 
 Let’s break down what terpenes are, how they influence your experience, and why they’re worth paying attention to when choosing cannabis products.
 
 What Are Terpenes? 
 Terpenes are naturally occurring aromatic compounds found in many plants—including cannabis. They’re responsible for the distinctive scents and flavors in everything from lavender to citrus to pine.
 
 In cannabis, terpenes do more than smell good—they also help shape the overall effects of each strain. That calming indica or energizing sativa? Terpenes are a big part of the reason why they feel different.
 
 What is The Entourage Effect? 
 Terpenes don’t work alone—they interact with cannabinoids like THC and CBD to create what scientists call the entourage effect . This means that the combination of compounds works together synergistically, enhancing the potential therapeutic effects of cannabis.
 
 For example, a strain high in both limonene and THC may feel more uplifting than a strain with the same THC level but different terpenes.
 
 What are the most common Cannabis Terpenes? 
 Here are a few of the most common terpenes found in cannabis and their potential effects:
 
 Myrcene – Earthy, musky scent. Known for relaxing, sedative effects.

 Limonene – Citrus aroma. Uplifting and mood-boosting.

 Caryophyllene – Peppery or spicy smell. Anti-inflammatory and may help with pain.

 Pinene – Piney aroma. Promotes alertness and focus.

 Linalool – Floral scent. Calming and may ease anxiety or stress.

 
 Why Do Terpenes Matter When Choosing Cannabis? 
 At Cape Cod Cannabis , we believe the best cannabis experience comes from understanding what you’re putting into your body. Instead of choosing based solely on THC percentage , consider terpene content and how you want to feel.
 
 Looking for deep relaxation after a day on the beach? Try a strain high in myrcene . Need focus and energy before a hike in the Cape Cod National Seashore? A limonene -rich sativa might be the move.
 
 Shop by Terpene at Cape Cod Cannabis 
 Whether you’re new to cannabis or a seasoned enthusiast, our team in Wellfleet, MA is here to help you explore strains and products that align with your goals— flavor, effect, and experience .
 
 Browse our menu online here or stop by to chat with one of our knowledgeable budtenders about terpene-rich flower, vapes, and edibles.
 
 For more information please visit our Terpene & Cannabinoid Guide .
 
 —

Home / Anatomy of a Moonrock 
 

 Anatomy of a Moonrock at Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet, MA 

 Cannabis moonrocks are a premium product in the cannabis industry, known for their high potency and unique composition. 

 A cannabis moonrock is typically made by coating cannabis flower with cannabis concentrate and then covering it in kief. The result combines three cannabis components — flower, concentrate and kief — into one infused flower product.

 Hover over HOTSPOTS (+) for more information.

 
 
 Flower

 Flower (also known as bud) is the smokable part of a Cannabis plant . Similar to plants like Willow and Kiwi, Cannabis plants are either male or female. The female Cannabis plant is the only one that produces the flowers, while the male plants produce the pollen necessary to create seeds. 

 
 Concentrate

 A viscous, golden liquid created by refining cannabis resin . Distillation allows the processor to isolate a desired compound from the cannabis plant and leave behind undesirable plant material. Distillates are commonly used in vape cartridges and can also be used in edibles, topicals, and other products. 

 
 Kief

 Kief , sometimes transliterated as keef, also known as "Dust" and "Chief" a.k.a cannabis crystals among other names, refers to the pure and clean collection of loose cannabis trichomes, which are accumulated by being sifted from cannabis flowers or buds with a mesh screen or sieve. 

 
 

 What Are Cannabis Moonrocks? 
 Cannabis moonrocks are a combination of several cannabis products, creating a potent and flavorful experience. They typically consist of:
 1. Flower: High-quality cannabis buds form the core of moonrocks. The flower is usually chosen for its high THC content and aromatic profile.
 
 2. Concentrate: The cannabis buds are dipped or coated in hash oil or another type of cannabis concentrate. This sticky layer adds an extra layer of potency. * Distillate may be used as the concentrate in some products .
 
 Concentrate vs. Distillates 
 2b. Cannabis concentrate is a broad category of concentrated cannabis extracts. Distillate is a highly refined type of cannabis extract produced through additional processing intended to concentrate particular cannabinoids. Depending on the formulation, terpenes or other ingredients may also be present.
 
 3. Kief: After being coated in concentrate, the buds are rolled in kief. Kief is the collection of trichomes, or the resin glands of the cannabis plant, which contain high concentrations of cannabinoids and terpenes. The kief coating gives moonrocks their signature frosty appearance.
 
 Characteristics 
 – Potency: Because moonrocks combine flower with concentrated cannabis extracts and kief, they can contain substantially higher cannabinoid concentrations than conventional cannabis flower. Potency varies by product, so consumers should review the product label and testing information before use.
 
 – Flavor and Aroma: The use of high-quality cannabis flower and concentrates means that moonrocks often have a rich and complex flavor and aroma profile. The terpenes from the flower and concentrate, along with the kief, contribute to a multi-layered sensory experience.
 
 – Appearance: Moonrocks are visually distinctive, often appearing as lumpy, dense nuggets with a sticky, oily exterior and a powdery coating of kief. They have a frosted look due to the kief.
 
 Usage 
 – Consumption Method: Moonrocks are best consumed using a glass pipe or bong due to their sticky and dense nature. Breaking them down with a grinder is not recommended as it can cause loss of kief and concentrate. Instead, they should be broken apart by hand.
 
 – Why are Moonrocks considered high-potency Cannabis? Because moonrocks combine cannabis flower, concentrate and kief, they can contain higher concentrations of cannabinoids than traditional flower. Individual experiences vary based on the specific product, cannabinoid and terpene profile, amount consumed and individual tolerance.
 
 Considerations 
 – Price: Due to the high-quality ingredients and the intensive production process, moonrocks tend to be more expensive than regular cannabis flower.
 
 – Dosage: Because of their high potency, users should start with a small amount to gauge their tolerance and avoid consuming too much at once.
 
 Summary 
 Cannabis moonrocks are a premium, high-potency product made by coating cannabis buds in distillate (or concentrate) and rolling them in kief. They offer a unique and intense experience, characterized by strong effects and rich flavors.
 
 Because moonrocks may contain higher concentrations of THC than conventional flower, adults who are unfamiliar with high-potency cannabis should review the product label carefully, begin conservatively and ask a knowledgeable budtender if they have questions about the product.

 
 
 
 SHOP MOONROCKS 
 
 

 Moonrocks / Infused Bud

 Scroll left-right to view products

 

 
 
 
 CLICK TO VIEW FAQ'S
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What is a cannabis moonrock?
 
 
 
 
 A cannabis moonrock is an infused cannabis product typically made from three components: cannabis flower, cannabis concentrate and kief. The flower is coated with concentrate and covered in kief, creating a product that can contain higher concentrations of cannabinoids than traditional flower.

 
 
 
 What are moonrocks made of?
 
 
 
 
 Cannabis Flower + Concentrate + Kief. *Distillate is sometime used instead of concentrate. 

 
 
 
 What is Kief?
 
 
 
 
 Kief is the collection of tiny, resinous trichomes that naturally form on cannabis flower. These trichomes contain cannabinoids and terpenes and can separate from the plant material during handling or processing. In a cannabis moonrock, kief is typically used as the outer coating, sticking to the layer of cannabis concentrate surrounding the flower.

 
 
 
 How are cannabis moonrocks typically consumed?
 
 
 
 
 Cannabis moonrocks are typically broken into small pieces by hand and consumed using a pipe, bowl or similar smoking device. Because moonrocks are dense and coated with cannabis concentrate and kief, they can be sticky and difficult to grind. Consumers should review the product label and potency information before use and start with a small amount, especially if they are unfamiliar with high potency cannabis products.

 
 
 
 Where can I find moonrocks on Cape Cod?
 
 
 
 
 Product availability changes frequently. Adults 21+ can check the current Cape Cod Cannabis menu online to see available moonrocks and other infused cannabis products at our recreational dispensary in Wellfleet, Massachusetts.

 Thank You, Cape Cod! Cape Cod Cannabis Wins Best CBD Store in the 2026 Cape Cod Choice Awards
 We have some exciting news to share, but more importantly, we have a very big thank you to give to Cape Cod.
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis has been voted the Best CBD Store on Cape Cod in the 2026 Cape Cod Choice Awards! 
 
 We are also incredibly proud to have placed Top 3 for Best Cannabis Dispensary on Cape Cod for 2026 .
 
 These recognitions mean a great deal to our entire team because they came from you: our customers, neighbors, visitors, friends, and the Cape Cod community that has supported us since we opened our doors in Wellfleet.
 
 Thank you, Cape Cod. We are truly grateful. 
 
 
 Voted Best CBD Store on Cape Cod
 Being named the Best CBD Store on Cape Cod is especially meaningful because education has always been an important part of what we do.
 
 CBD can sometimes be confusing. Customers have questions about different product types, cannabinoids, formulations, serving sizes, labels, and how CBD differs from THC.
 
 We believe those questions deserve clear, straightforward answers.
 
 At Cape Cod Cannabis, customers can explore a wide variety of CBD products on Cape Cod , including tinctures, topicals, edibles, beverages, and other options, while having access to a knowledgeable team that can help explain the differences.
 
 Our goal isn’t simply to put products on a shelf.
 
 It’s to help customers better understand what they’re buying so they can make more informed choices.
 
 Being voted Best CBD Store on Cape Cod for 2026 tells us that approach matters, and we couldn’t be more appreciative.
 
 
 
 Top 3 Finalist for the Best Cannabis Dispensary on Cape Cod
 We are equally honored that Cape Cod voters placed Cape Cod Cannabis among the Top 3 Finalist for the Best Cannabis Dispensaries on Cape Cod for 2026 .
 
 Since opening in Wellfleet, we’ve worked to create a recreational dispensary experience that feels approachable, welcoming, and distinctly Cape Cod.
 
 Whether you’re a longtime customer, someone exploring cannabis for the first time, a Cape Cod resident, or a visitor spending a few days on the Outer Cape, we want you to feel comfortable walking through our doors.
 
 No pressure. No need to already know everything about cannabis. 
 
 Come in, ask questions, explore, and let our team help.
 
 One of the Largest Cannabis Selections on Cape Cod
 Choice matters.
 
 That’s why we’ve worked hard to offer the largest selection of quality cannabis products at the best prices on Cape Cod . 
 
 Our Wellfleet dispensary carries a broad selection that includes:
 
 Flower 
 Pre-rolls 
 Edibles 
 Vape products 
 Concentrates 
 Tinctures 
 Topicals 
 CBD products 
 Beverages 
 Seeds 
 Accessories 
 Apparel 
 
 We continually evaluate our selection to give customers access to established favorites, Massachusetts brands, new products, different price points, and plenty of choices.
 
 But having a large selection is only useful when customers can understand it.
 
 That’s where education comes in.
 
 Cannabis Education Is Part of Who We Are
 Cannabis has changed considerably over the years, and today’s marketplace gives consumers more choices than ever before.
 
 That can also make shopping confusing.
 
 What’s the difference between THC and CBD? What are terpenes ? How are edibles different from flower? What’s a tincture? What’s the difference between live resin and live rosin? How do Massachusetts cannabis purchase limits work?
 
 We want our customers to ask those questions. 
 Our team takes an education first approach to helping customers navigate cannabis. We also continue building our online Cannabis 101 educational resources so people can learn before they ever walk through our doors.
 
 We believe an informed customer can make a more confident decision.
 
 That philosophy is at the heart of Cape Cod Cannabis. 
 
 More Than a Dispensary in Wellfleet
 Being part of Cape Cod means being part of the community.
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis is proud to support local events, organizations, charitable initiatives, chambers of commerce, artists, businesses, and community programs throughout the Cape.
 
 You’ve seen us supporting events such as the Outer Cape Music Festival , participating in community programs, creating free educational resources , and looking for new ways to contribute to the place we call home.
 
 For us, being a Cape Cod business means more than having a Cape Cod address.
 
 It means participating.
 
 It means supporting other local businesses and organizations.
 
 And it means giving back to the community that supports us.
 
 Trusted by Locals, Loved by Visitors
 One of the things we’re most proud of is the community of customers we’ve built over the years.
 
 Some have been visiting Cape Cod Cannabis since we first opened.
 
 Others find us while vacationing in Wellfleet, Eastham, Truro, Provincetown, Orleans, or elsewhere on the Outer Cape.
 
 Some know exactly what they’re looking for.
 
 Others walk in with a lot of questions.
 
 We welcome all of them.
 
 It’s why we’ve worked to create a low stress, education focused dispensary experience centered around personalized service rather than simply completing a transaction.
 
 And it’s why recognition from the Cape Cod Choice Awards means so much to us.
 
 Looking for the Best CBD Store or a Cannabis Dispensary on Cape Cod?
 If you’re searching for the Best CBD Store on Cape Cod , a cannabis dispensary in Wellfleet , or simply a dispensary near me while exploring the Outer Cape, we invite you to visit Cape Cod Cannabis.
 
 You’ll find us on Route 6 in South Wellfleet , conveniently located for residents and visitors traveling between Eastham, Wellfleet, Truro, Provincetown, Orleans, and beyond.
 
 Come explore our selection, meet our team, ask questions, and discover what makes Cape Cod Cannabis different.
 
 This Award Belongs to Our Customers and Community
 Awards are wonderful.
 
 But what matters most to us is who voted for them .
 
 Every visit, recommendation, review , conversation, vote, and kind word has helped Cape Cod Cannabis become what it is today.
 
 To everyone who voted Cape Cod Cannabis the Best CBD Store on Cape Cod for 2026 and helped place us among the Top 3 Best Cannabis Dispensaries on Cape Cod , thank you.
 
 To our loyal customers who have been with us year after year, thank you. 
 To the visitors who make Cape Cod Cannabis part of their Cape experience, thank you. 
 To our team for the work they put in every day, thank you. 
 
 And to the Cape Cod community that continues to support us:
 
 We are grateful. We are proud to be part of this community. And we look forward to continuing to earn your trust every single day. 
 
 Thank You, Cape Cod! 
 
 From all of us at Cape Cod Cannabis, thank you for your votes, your loyalty, and your continued support. 
 
 We’ll continue doing what got us here: offering a huge selection of quality products, some of the best prices on Cape Cod, personalized service, straightforward cannabis education, and a welcoming experience for adults 21+.

 Beyond Bud: Cape Cod Cannabis and our exclusive Blue Tail Apparel and Merch 
 
 Introduction: 
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis offers its exclusive Blue Tail Apparel , for adults 21 and over, to redefine not just how we experience cannabis but how we express our lifestyles. Join us as we explore the synergy between Cape Cod’s natural beauty, the evolving cannabis scene, and the unique style brought to you by Blue Tail Apparel ( www.BlueTail.cc – Shipped to you) .
 
 From Blooms to Threads: 
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis has long been associated with premium cannabis products, cultivating a community that appreciates quality and innovation. Now, with the launch of our new Blue Tail Apparel website ( www.BlueTail.cc ) that offers convenient, safe and secure online shopping and shipping your new apparel to your home, we’re continuing our commitment to excellence in the realm of branded fashion…marking a significant evolution for the brand.
 
 Elevating Cannabis Fashion: 
 
 More than just a clothing line, Blue Tail Apparel from Cape Cod Cannabis is an exploration of the evolving cannabis lifestyle. Celebrating the culture with sophistication and style. From casual tees that make a subtle statement to bold hoodies that proudly embrace the cannabis connection, the collection is a testament to the brand’s commitment to elevating cannabis fashion.
 
 Quality and Comfort at the Core: 
 
 Known for its dedication to quality, Cape Cod Cannabis ensures that the Blue Tail Apparel line meets the same standards. The collection features premium materials, ensuring not only style but also comfort. From the moment you put on a Blue Tail piece, you’ll experience the same attention to detail and craftsmanship that has defined Cape Cod Cannabis products.
 
 Limited Edition Drops: 
 
 Adding an extra layer of exclusivity, Cape Cod Cannabis is set to release limited edition Blue Tail Apparel drops. These unique designs, available for a limited time, showcase the creativity and innovation that define both the cannabis and fashion industries. It’s an opportunity for enthusiasts to own a piece of the evolving cultural narrative.
 
 Where to Find Blue Tail Apparel: 
 
 Explore the exclusive Blue Tail Apparel line by Cape Cod Cannabis on our official website, www.BlueTail.cc (shipped to you anywhere in the USA), or visit us in Wellfleet and purchase in-store (pre-orders at www.CapeCodCannabis.com ) for local pickup. Our online platform provides a convenient and secure shopping experience, allowing you to seamlessly integrate the essence of Cape Cod and the cannabis lifestyle into your wardrobe.
 
 Conclusion: 
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis’s deeper dive in to fashion with the recent launch of Blue Tail Apparel website ( www.BlueTail.cc ) marks a significant milestone in the brand’s journey. By merging the natural beauty of Cape Cod with the evolving cannabis culture, they’ve created a collection that goes beyond threads—it’s a lifestyle statement. Join the movement, discover Blue Tail Apparel, and wear the essence of Cape Cod Cannabis’ vibe with pride. Stay tuned for more…

 June 1, 2026 
 
 

 Home / Cape Cod Lifestyle / Boards in the Stores 2026 Returns to Cape Cod 
 

 Boards in the Stores 2026 Returns to Cape Cod: Support Local Artists, Local Business, and the Orleans Chamber of Commerce
 Summer on Cape Cod is about more than beaches, sunsets, and oysters. It is also a time to celebrate the creativity, community, and local businesses that make the Cape such a special place to live and visit. One of the most anticipated community events each summer is the Boards in the Stores 2026 Online Auction , hosted annually by the Orleans Chamber of Commerce .
 
 Beginning June 5, 2026 , and running through August 2026 , this unique fundraising event brings together local artists and local businesses to create one of the most exciting online auctions on Cape Cod. This year, Cape Cod Cannabis is proud to once again participate as a sponsor.
 
 

 

 (Wait a few seconds to see…) 

 
 
 
 CLOSED BIDDING. Check results. 
 
 

 
 What Is Boards in the Stores?
 Boards in the Stores is a Cape Cod tradition that combines art, community, and philanthropy.
 
 The concept is simple. Local businesses sponsor a surfboard shaped art board and partner with a local artist who transforms it into a one of a kind work of art. Each board is then featured in the online auction where community members, visitors, collectors, and supporters can place bids throughout the summer.
 
 Every board tells a story and showcases the incredible talent found throughout Cape Cod. The result is a gallery of creative pieces inspired by the Cape’s natural beauty, culture, wildlife, and coastal lifestyle.
 
 
 Supporting the Orleans Chamber and Local Artists
 One of the reasons Boards in the Stores has become such a beloved event is that it directly benefits both the community and the artists involved.
 
 50 Percent of Proceeds Support the Orleans Chamber of Commerce
 The Orleans Chamber of Commerce works year round to promote local businesses, support economic development, and strengthen the communities of the Lower and Outer Cape. Funds raised through the auction help support programs, events, and initiatives that benefit residents, visitors, and businesses alike.
 
 50 Percent of Proceeds Go Directly to the Artist
 Artists are the heart of this event. Each board represents countless hours of creativity, craftsmanship, and passion. By participating in the auction, bidders are directly supporting local Cape Cod artists while also investing in a unique piece of coastal art. It is truly a win for everyone involved. 
 
 
 
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis’ 2026 Sponsored Board
 For the 2026 auction, Cape Cod Cannabis partnered with local artist Cape Cod Land Shark , known for creating handcrafted whimsical wood art inspired by life on Cape Cod. Our sponsored board captures the spirit of the Cape with a vibrant coastal scene featuring ocean waves, a rising sun, seabirds, whales and a heart inspired by community and connection.
 What makes this board even more unique is that it features LED lighting , allowing the artwork to come alive both day and night.
 The board reflects everything we love about Cape Cod:
 
 Natural beauty
 Creativity
 Community spirit
 Coastal adventure
 Local collaboration
 
 We are incredibly proud of the finished piece and excited to share it with the public during the auction.
 
 
 Why Local Partnerships Matter
 At Cape Cod Cannabis, supporting local artists and organizations is part of who we are. As a locally owned business in Wellfleet, we believe that strong communities are built when local businesses invest in local talent and community organizations.
 Events like Boards in the Stores showcase the best of Cape Cod by bringing together:
 
 Artists
 Small businesses
 Community organizations
 Residents
 Visitors
 
 These partnerships help preserve the unique character that makes Cape Cod unlike anywhere else.
 
 
 How to Participate in the Auction
 Participating is easy. Beginning June 5 through August 19, 2026, visitors can browse the collection of sponsored boards online and place bids on their favorite pieces. Click here to bid! 
 
 Whether you are a collector, an art enthusiast, or simply someone who loves supporting local causes, Boards in the Stores offers an opportunity to own a truly one of a kind piece of Cape Cod artwork while supporting meaningful community initiatives. Keep an eye on the Orleans Chamber of Commerce website and social media channels for auction details, bidding information, and featured boards.
 
 

 
 
 
 CLOSED BIDDING. Check results. 
 
 
 Boards in the Stores Scavenger Hunt 2026
 Surf through Orleans (our board is in Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet ) and earn points for finding our Boards in the Stores on each mission!
 
 HOW TO PLAY: 
 Download the Goosechase App for iOS or Android
 Enter Join Code / Experience Name: PBCT3F 
 or scan the QR code below to get started.
 
 
 
 

 
 
 Our Winning Board 2025
 
 
 Visit Cape Cod Cannabis This Summer
 As the unofficial start of the summer season arrives, we invite visitors and locals alike to stop by Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet .

 Can I Overdose on Cannabis?

 
 
 
 
 
 November 14, 2021 
 
 

 Home / Cannabis 101 / Can I Overdose on Cannabis? 
 

 Can I Overdose on Cannabis?
 Everyone has something called an endocannabinoid system (ECS). This system is important for maintaining homeostasis, which refers to various processes that stabilize our internal environment. The ECS contains cannabinoid receptors throughout the body that THC binds to. Some of these receptors are abundantly present in three main parts of our brain—the cerebellum, basal ganglia, and hippocampus regions. None of these three regions play a large role in basic life functions such as breathing and heart rate. This is why cannabis users don’t overdose like opioid users do. Unfortunately, opioid receptors are plentiful in the brain stem which results in users becoming more susceptible to sudden death. Of course, it’s not impossible to die from marijuana, but extremely difficult. It’s predicted you’d have to smoke about 1,500 pounds of cannabis in fifteen minutes for it to be lethal. The lack of oxygen in trying to do so would probably asphyxiate you first though.
 
 Although cannabis users are not prone to suddenly dying from too much THC intake, other unpleasant symptoms could occur. Some refer to this as “greening out.” I’ve only experienced this once in my ten years of using cannabis. I made chocolate chip cookies infused with way too much granddaddy purple distillate and endured a night of anxiety, sweats, nausea, increased heart rate, and paranoia. I had convinced myself there were monsters in my closet and laid in bed frozen so I wouldn’t catch their attention. I woke up for my opening shift at work the next morning and realized as I was driving that I was still terribly high. Unfortunately, you just have to ride the wave until it’s over. Taking CBD to dilute the high can help. You can also try eating black pepper or drinking lemon juice, both of which have terpenes known to calm you down.

 Home / Cannabinoids 
 

 Shop Cannabis Cannabinoids For Sale in Wellfleet, MA

 Explore the world of cannabinoids at Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet, MA. Our dispensary offers a diverse selection of cannabis products rich in cannabinoids like THC, CBD, CBG, CBC, and CBN, each interacting with your body’s endocannabinoid system to support functions such as mood, sleep, and pain management. Whether you’re seeking relaxation, relief, or rejuvenation, our knowledgeable team is here to guide you to the right product. Visit us to experience the benefits of cannabinoids and discover why Cape Cod Cannabis is a trusted destination for cannabis enthusiasts.

 
 
 
 WHAT ARE CANNABINOIDS?
 
 
 
 
 Cannabinoids are naturally occurring chemical compounds found in the cannabis plant that interact with the body’s endocannabinoid system (ECS) —a network of receptors involved in regulating many physiological functions like mood, pain, appetite, sleep, and immune response.
 
 There are three main types of cannabinoids:
 
 1. Phytocannabinoids (from cannabis) 
 These are the cannabinoids found in cannabis plants. Some of the most well-known include:
 
 THC (tetrahydrocannabinol) – The primary psychoactive compound responsible for the “high.”

 CBD (cannabidiol) – Non-psychoactive; known for potential benefits like reducing anxiety, inflammation, and seizures.

 CBG (cannabigerol) – A precursor to other cannabinoids; studied for mood, pain, and antibacterial properties.

 CBC (cannabichromene) – Non-intoxicating; may support pain relief and neurogenesis.

 CBN (cannabinol) – Formed as THC degrades; mildly psychoactive with potential sedative effects.

 
 2. Endocannabinoids (from the body) 
 These are produced naturally by the human body and include:
 
 Anandamide – Sometimes called the “bliss molecule”; binds to cannabinoid receptors and helps regulate mood and appetite.

 2-AG (2-arachidonoylglycerol) – Involved in regulating immune function and inflammation.

 
 3. Synthetic Cannabinoids 
 Man-made compounds designed to mimic natural cannabinoids. Some are used medically (e.g., dronabinol ) while others (e.g., Spice , K2 ) are illegal and often dangerous.
 
 What Do Cannabinoids Do? 
 Cannabinoids bind to CB1 and CB2 receptors in the body:
 
 CB1 receptors are mainly in the brain and central nervous system—linked to mood, memory, and pain perception.

 CB2 receptors are found in the immune system—linked to inflammation and pain relief.

 
 Together with terpenes , cannabinoids contribute to the entourage effect , where compounds work together to enhance each other’s therapeutic potential.
 

 

 
 
 
 TOP 9 CANNABINOIDS
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 Shop All Cannabinoids

 
 
“TAC” – Total Active Cannabinoids 
 TAC, or Total Active Cannabinoids, refers to the combined percentage of all active cannabinoids in a cannabis product, including THC. It’s more than just THC; it encompasses other cannabinoids like CBD, CBN, and CBG, providing a broader picture of the product’s overall potency and potential effects.

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
CBCV (Cannabichromevarin) 
 CBCV (Cannabichromevarin) is a minor cannabinoid found in cannabis, structurally related to CBC (Cannabichromene), but with a slight variation in its chemical structure. Like other varin-type cannabinoids, CBCV has a propyl side chain rather than the more common pentyl side chain found in CBC and other cannabinoids like THC and CBD.

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
CBDV (Cannabidivarin) 
 CBDV (Cannabidivarin) is a non-psychoactive cannabinoid found in cannabis and hemp, closely related to CBD (Cannabidiol) in structure and effects. It’s a member of the “varin” family of cannabinoids, which are known for having a shorter side chain than their more common counterparts.

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
CBL (Cannabicyclol) 
 CBL (Cannabicyclol) is a lesser-known, non-psychoactive cannabinoid found in the cannabis plant. It’s considered a degradation product, meaning it forms when other cannabinoids—mainly CBC (Cannabichromene)—break down over time due to light, heat, or air exposure.

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
CBNA (Cannabinolic Acid) 
 CBNA (Cannabinolic Acid) is the acidic precursor to CBN (Cannabinol) and is found in raw, unheated cannabis. It forms when THCA (tetrahydrocannabinolic acid) is exposed to oxygen over time, undergoing a natural process called oxidation.

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
CBDA (Cannabidiolic acid) 
 Cannabidiolic acid, is a cannabinoid produced in cannabis plants. It is the precursor to cannabidiol. It is most abundant in the glandular trichomes on the female seedless flowers or more accurately infructescence often colloquially referred to as buds or flowers.

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
CBC (Cannabichromene) 
 Cannabichromene (CBC) is a non-psychoactive cannabinoid found in cannabis, meaning it doesn’t produce a “high” like THC. It’s considered one of the “big six” cannabinoids and is being studied for its potential therapeutic effects, including anti-inflammatory, anti-nociceptive, and anti-cancer properties.

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
THCV (Tetrahydrocannabivarin) 
 THCV (Tetrahydrocannabivarin) is a psychoactive cannabinoid found in cannabis, known for its distinct effects compared to Delta-9 THC. It shares a similar chemical structure with THC but tends to produce different effects on the body and mind.

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
CBCA (Cannabichromenenic acid) 
 CBCA (Cannabichromenic Acid) is the acidic precursor to CBC (Cannabichromene), one of the lesser-known, non-psychoactive cannabinoids found in cannabis. Like other cannabinoid acids, CBCA exists in raw, unheated cannabis and decays into CBC when exposed to heat (through decarboxylation).

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
CBN (Cannabinol) 
 CBN (Cannabinol) is a mildly psychoactive cannabinoid found in cannabis, best known as a byproduct of THC degradation. When THC ages—due to exposure to heat, light, or oxygen—it breaks down into CBN. That’s why older cannabis often has higher levels of CBN.

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
CBDVA (Cannabidivarinic acid) 
 Cannabidivarinic acid (CBDVA) is the carboxylic acid precursor of cannabidivarin (CBDV), a close chemical relative to cannabidiol (CBD). All of these substances originate in Cannabis sativa, and CBDVA, CBDV, and CBD share more similarities than differences.

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
CBLA (Cannabicyclolic Acid) 
 CBLA (Cannabicyclolic Acid) is the acidic precursor to CBL (Cannabicyclol) — a rare and non-psychoactive cannabinoid. Like many other cannabinoid acids, CBLA exists naturally in raw, unheated cannabis, and it degrades from CBCA (Cannabichromenic Acid) over time, especially when exposed to light or heat.

 
 
Shop Now ⭢

 Home / Cannabinoids / Page 2 
 

 Shop Cannabis Cannabinoids For Sale in Wellfleet, MA

 Explore the world of cannabinoids at Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet, MA. Our dispensary offers a diverse selection of cannabis products rich in cannabinoids like THC, CBD, CBG, CBC, and CBN, each interacting with your body’s endocannabinoid system to support functions such as mood, sleep, and pain management. Whether you’re seeking relaxation, relief, or rejuvenation, our knowledgeable team is here to guide you to the right product. Visit us to experience the benefits of cannabinoids and discover why Cape Cod Cannabis is a trusted destination for cannabis enthusiasts.

 
 
 
 WHAT ARE CANNABINOIDS?
 
 
 
 
 Cannabinoids are naturally occurring chemical compounds found in the cannabis plant that interact with the body’s endocannabinoid system (ECS) —a network of receptors involved in regulating many physiological functions like mood, pain, appetite, sleep, and immune response.
 
 There are three main types of cannabinoids:
 
 1. Phytocannabinoids (from cannabis) 
 These are the cannabinoids found in cannabis plants. Some of the most well-known include:
 
 THC (tetrahydrocannabinol) – The primary psychoactive compound responsible for the “high.”

 CBD (cannabidiol) – Non-psychoactive; known for potential benefits like reducing anxiety, inflammation, and seizures.

 CBG (cannabigerol) – A precursor to other cannabinoids; studied for mood, pain, and antibacterial properties.

 CBC (cannabichromene) – Non-intoxicating; may support pain relief and neurogenesis.

 CBN (cannabinol) – Formed as THC degrades; mildly psychoactive with potential sedative effects.

 
 2. Endocannabinoids (from the body) 
 These are produced naturally by the human body and include:
 
 Anandamide – Sometimes called the “bliss molecule”; binds to cannabinoid receptors and helps regulate mood and appetite.

 2-AG (2-arachidonoylglycerol) – Involved in regulating immune function and inflammation.

 
 3. Synthetic Cannabinoids 
 Man-made compounds designed to mimic natural cannabinoids. Some are used medically (e.g., dronabinol ) while others (e.g., Spice , K2 ) are illegal and often dangerous.
 
 What Do Cannabinoids Do? 
 Cannabinoids bind to CB1 and CB2 receptors in the body:
 
 CB1 receptors are mainly in the brain and central nervous system—linked to mood, memory, and pain perception.

 CB2 receptors are found in the immune system—linked to inflammation and pain relief.

 
 Together with terpenes , cannabinoids contribute to the entourage effect , where compounds work together to enhance each other’s therapeutic potential.
 

 

 
 
 
 TOP 9 CANNABINOIDS
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 Shop All Cannabinoids

 
 
THCV (Tetrahydrocannabivarin) 
 THCV (Tetrahydrocannabivarin) is a psychoactive cannabinoid found in cannabis, known for its distinct effects compared to Delta-9 THC. It shares a similar chemical structure with THC but tends to produce different effects on the body and mind.

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
CBCA (Cannabichromenenic acid) 
 CBCA (Cannabichromenic Acid) is the acidic precursor to CBC (Cannabichromene), one of the lesser-known, non-psychoactive cannabinoids found in cannabis. Like other cannabinoid acids, CBCA exists in raw, unheated cannabis and decays into CBC when exposed to heat (through decarboxylation).

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
CBN (Cannabinol) 
 CBN (Cannabinol) is a mildly psychoactive cannabinoid found in cannabis, best known as a byproduct of THC degradation. When THC ages—due to exposure to heat, light, or oxygen—it breaks down into CBN. That’s why older cannabis often has higher levels of CBN.

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
THCA (Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinolic acid) 
 THCA (Δ9-Tetrahydrocannabinolic Acid) is the non-psychoactive, acidic precursor to Delta-9 THC — the cannabinoid responsible for the cannabis “high.” THCA is found in raw, unheated cannabis and only becomes psychoactive after decarboxylation, a process triggered by heat (like smoking, vaping, or cooking).

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
CBG (Cannabigerol) 
 CBG (Cannabigerol) is a non-psychoactive cannabinoid found in the cannabis plant. It’s often referred to as the “mother of all cannabinoids” because it’s the precursor from which other cannabinoids like THC and CBD are synthesized.

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
CBGA (Cannabigerolic acid) 
 CBGA (Cannabigerolic Acid) is a naturally occurring acidic precursor cannabinoid found in raw cannabis. It’s often called the “mother cannabinoid” because it’s the first cannabinoid the plant produces — and the one that eventually turns into other major cannabinoids like THCA, CBDA, and CBCA.

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
THCVA (Tetrahydrocanabivarinic acid) 
 THCVA (Tetrahydrocannabivarinic Acid) is the acidic precursor to THCV (Tetrahydrocannabivarin), found in raw, unheated cannabis. Like other cannabinoid acids, THCVA transforms into its active, psychoactive form — THCV — when exposed to heat (such as during decarboxylation).

 
 
Shop Now ⭢ 

 
 
THC-D9 (Delta 9–tetrahydrocannabinol) 
 THC-D9 (Delta-9-Tetrahydrocannabinol) is the primary psychoactive compound in cannabis — it’s the one most responsible for the classic cannabis “high.” Delta-9 binds with receptors in the brain’s endocannabinoid system, producing effects that range from euphoria and relaxation to altered perception and increased appetite.

Cannabis 101

 Cannabis is a plant with unique essential oil: cannabinoids. Cannabinoids have a medicinal effect by imitating compounds our bodies naturally produce (endocannabinoids). There are over 85 cannabinoids in cannabis, but the main two that you should know about are:

 THC

 (DELTA-9-TETRAHYDROCANNABINOL)
 
 THC is responsible for the psychoactive (“stoned”) effects. Commonly experienced effects include euphoria, relaxation, and “giggles”.

 CBD

 (CANNABIDIOL)
 
 CBD has little to no psychoactive effects and can balance or counteract the anxiety produced by THC. CBD can reduce anxiety, provide pain relief, suppress nausea, support cardiovascular health, and have anti-inflammatory properties.

 Did you know? Terpenes are another oil of cannabis plant that contribute to the effect on your body. Most common terpenes are Pinene, Myrcene, Limonene, Caryophyllene, Linalool, Humulene .
 Cannabis can be classified into two categories based on its effects:

 SATIVA

 Increases energy, focus, elevates mood, increases creativity.
 Consumed during Daytime.
 

 INDICA

 Relaxes and reduces stress, pain, and anxiety, promotes sleep and reduces inflammation.
 Consumed at Nighttime.
 

 Remember: Most cannabis strains are HYBRIDS and their effect fall somewhere between the two.
 
 All products vary in their strength of effect on body and mid. Each person is unique and may experience cannabis differently. Read the packaging label for product laboratory results and consumption suggestions. Always start with a small dose and wait until getting another one.
