 Understanding the 28-Gram Daily Limit
 
 
 
 
 Understanding the 28-Gram Daily Limit 
 The state allows you to purchase 28 grams of flower or its equivalent in other cannabis formats. Let’s break down how these limits apply:
 
 • Flower : Up to 28 grams (1 ounce).
 • Edibles : A total of 500mg THC , which is roughly 5 packs of 20 servings , each serving containing 5mg of THC .
 • Concentrates : Up to 5 grams of cannabis concentrates, such as wax, shatter, or live resin (equivalent to 5 x 1g or 10 x 0.5g packages).
 • Tinctures : A total of 5000mg = approximately 5 x 1000mg bottles , depending on the product’s potency and total THC content.
 • Pre-roll Joints : 28 pre-roll joints , assuming each joint contains roughly 1 gram of flower .
 • Vape Cartridges : Up to 10 x 0.5g cartridges or 5 x 1g cartridges/disposables .

 
 
 
 Why Are Purchase Limits Important?
 
 
 
 
 Massachusetts’ purchase limits serve three critical purposes:
 
 • Encourage Responsible Use : Limiting daily purchases helps consumers manage their intake responsibly.
 • Prevent Diversion : Restricting quantities reduces the risk of products entering the illicit market.
 • Promote Safety : Regulating how much THC a consumer can access in one day helps prevent overconsumption.
 

 
 
 
 Tips for Staying Within the Limit
 
 
 
 
 • Know Your Preferences : Decide what products suit your needs—flower, concentrates, edibles, or a mix.
 • Plan Ahead : If you intend to purchase multiple product types, calculate the total equivalency before checkout.
 • Consult the Experts : Dispensary staff can help you understand product potencies and their impact on the daily limit.

 IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT CANNABIS:
 Marijuana and Marijuana Products have not been analyzed or approved by the FDA, therefore there is limited information on side effects. There may be health risks associate with using marijuana or marijuana products. All marijuana and marijuana products should be kept away from children.
 
 Under M.G.L. c90, §24 it is illegal to drive or operate machinery under the influence of marijuana.
 
 We always recommend speaking with a physician regarding dosage. For consumers who are new to cannabis we recommend starting with smallest dosage according to package directions and allowing sufficient time to pass to allow effects to be felt, based on the method of consumption or application.
 Tolerance, dependence and withdrawal have not been researched therefore please consume marijuana and marijuana products at your now risk.
 
 If you or someone you know is exhibiting signs or symptoms of substance abuse please contact the Massachusetts Substance Abuse Helpline at 800 327 5050 for further assistance.
 
 Consumer may not sell marijuana to any other individual, doing so may impose a fine and/or imprisonment; likewise registered qualifying patients may not distribute marijuana to any other individual, and that they must return unused, excess, or contaminated product to the RMD from which they purchased the product, for disposal.
 
 For information regarding penalties for possession or distribution of marijuana in violation of Massachusetts law Please refer to M.G.L. c94G, §13 .
 
 For additional educational materials please refer to Intro to Cannabis 101. 
 
 For FAQs (frequently asked questions) please visit our FAQ page . Feel to contact us directly during regular business hours at (774) 383-3133 for assistance.
 
 Please consume cannabis products responsibly.
 
 Cannabis is for use only by adults 21 years of age or older. All information contained herein and, on our website, www.capecodcannabis.com, is for educational purposes only. None of this information should be interpreted as medical or treatment advice for any person or condition. Always consult with a licensed physician in all matters regarding your health.
 

 
 
 

 Please Consume Responsibly. This product may cause impairment and may be habit forming. For use only by adults 21 years of age or older. Keep out of the reach of children.  Provincetown is also celebrated for its rich cultural and artistic heritage. The town has been a haven for artists, writers, and performers for decades, and this creative spirit is evident in its numerous galleries, theaters, and arts festivals. The Provincetown Art Association and Museum showcases works from local and national artists, while the town’s many galleries and studios offer a wide range of art to explore and purchase.
 
 Historic landmarks, such as the Pilgrim Monument and Provincetown Museum , commemorate the town’s significance in American history. The Pilgrim Monument, which stands as the tallest all-granite structure in the United States, marks the spot where the Pilgrims first landed in 1620 before settling in Plymouth.
 
 Downtown Provincetown is a bustling and diverse area, with an array of shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues. Visitors can explore unique boutiques, dine at seafood restaurants offering fresh local catches, and enjoy vibrant nightlife, including live music and drag shows.
 
 With its blend of natural beauty, artistic vibrancy, historic significance, and lively community, Provincetown offers a dynamic and memorable Cape Cod experience. pages.metaDescription: Dosage | Your dosing will of course vary depending on how you are consuming cannabis. We will start with the easiest method of dosing, which is smoking. Smoking provides you with almost instant effects due to THC passing from the lungs and into the bloodstream. The bloodstream then rapidly delivers the cannabinoids to the brain. Because of this, users can simply take a small puff from their desired delivery device, wait a moment to see how they feel, and re-dose if necessary. Some will be more than satisfied with a hit or two from a joint. Others may seek heavier effects or have a larger tolerance to THC and thus will smoke as much as a few grams at a time. Smokers can expect this high to last a couple hours, or less for those with a tolerance. Vaping will have the same onset and duration.

 Dosage

 
 
 
 
 
 November 28, 2021 
 
 

 Home / Cannabis 101 / Dosage 
 

 Dosage
 Your dosing will of course vary depending on how you are consuming cannabis. We will start with the easiest method of dosing, which is smoking. Smoking provides you with almost instant effects due to THC passing from the lungs and into the bloodstream. The bloodstream then rapidly delivers the cannabinoids to the brain. Because of this, users can simply take a small puff from their desired delivery device, wait a moment to see how they feel, and re-dose if necessary. Some will be more than satisfied with a hit or two from a joint. Others may seek heavier effects or have a larger tolerance to THC and thus will smoke as much as a few grams at a time. Smokers can expect this high to last a couple hours, or less for those with a tolerance. Vaping will have the same onset and duration.
 
 Edibles, tinctures, and other oral or sublingual means of consumption will be measured in milligrams of THC. A standard starting dose for beginners is 5 mgs. For some people, this is just enough to get a moderate high without being too much. One important thing to remember is that responses to THC vary greatly and it’s going to be trial and error to find your perfect dose. I’ve known large men who get too high from 5 mgs, and I’ve known petite women who needed 100 mgs to feel anything their first time using cannabis. The spectrum is quite wide and we chalk this up to everyone’s individual body chemistry, rather than gender or weight. Starting low and slow is always the safest way to familiarize yourself with cannabis.

 Dry Herb – Why make the switch?

 
 
 
 
 
 February 12, 2024 
 
 

 Home / Cannabis 101 / Dry Herb – Why make the switch? 
 

 Dry Herb – Why make the switch?
 The majority of dry herb vapes are convenient electronic devices that allow the vaporization of cannabinoids without combusting plant material. The lack of combustion in these devices leads to a smoother draw that is less harsh on the throat than traditional smoking methods. With a smoother pull, many people who make the switch to vaping have found they are able to pick up on the aromas and terpenes that are normally just a subtle taste when smoking. Along with improved flavor and draw, many dry herb vape users have found that it is easier to conserve their weed once they make the switch. There’s a whole world of vaping out there ready for you to explore!
 
 Generally smoking negatively impacts the mucous membrane, reducing the extent to which you can taste and smell, dry herb vaping is able to avoid this all together. The ability to discern the different terpenes and aromas truly highlights the individuality of each cultivar and allows for a more refined taste when it comes to choosing your cannabis. When shopping for bud to use in a dry herb vape, look for the freshest and highest quality cannabis. Dense and sticky buds perform the best in dry herbs vapes and tend to lead to a thicker “milkier” cloud of vapor along with a stronger flavor profile. Sometimes, with the right bud and tolerance, one bowl from a dry herb vape can be enough for even a seasoned smoker.
 
 Dry herb vapes are able to more efficiently extract the cannabinoids in the plant without destroying them in the smoking process. One bowl of a dry herb vape can be used for multiple sessions until the weed has become fully vaped at which point it is referred to as ABV (already been vaped). Once finished with a vape bowl, the ABV still has some cannabinoids left in it and can be used to make cannabutter or other infusions for edibles. Being able to have multiple vapor sessions off a single bowl and use the weed you’ve already vaped for edibles truly makes dry herb vapes the gift that keeps on giving. If you want to get the most out of your cannabis consumption, give a dry herb vape a try! 
 
 Mitch Arruda – Cape Cod Cannabis Product Specialist

 Embracing the End of Summer on Cape Cod

 
 
 
 
 
 August 28, 2025 
 
 

 Home / Cape Cod Lifestyle / Embracing the End of Summer on Cape Cod 
 

 Embracing the End of Summer on Cape Cod
 
 As we approach the end of summer, there’s a bittersweet feeling that settles in across Cape Cod. The long, sunny days that seemed endless are now beginning to shorten, and there’s a hint of autumn in the evening breeze. It’s a time of reflection, gratitude, and preparation for the seasonal shift. Here at Cape Cod Cannabis , we’re taking a moment to look back on what makes summer on the Cape so magical—and how we can help you carry that summer spirit into the cooler months ahead. 
 
 The Magic of a Cape Cod Summer 
 Cape Cod in the summer is nothing short of enchanting. From the bustling energy of Provincetown to the quiet charm of Wellfleet, Chatham, Sandwich or Falmouth, every corner of the Cape offers its own unique allure. Tourists and locals alike revel in the natural beauty that surrounds us—beaches with powdery sand, crystal-clear waters, and scenic trails that meander through salt marshes and pine forests. 
 
 Whether it’s a day spent on the beach, a bike ride along the Cape Cod Rail Trail (Cape Cod Cannabis is located at Mile Marker 22 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza on Rt. 6), or an evening of fresh seafood at a local restaurant, summer here is all about savoring life’s simple pleasures. 
 
 For many, summer on Cape Cod is also about relaxation and rejuvenation. After a long, cold winter, the warm sun and ocean breezes are a welcome relief, offering a chance to unwind and reconnect with nature. At Cape Cod Cannabis, we are proud to be a part of that relaxation for many of you. Whether you’ve chosen us for a pre-beach day boost or an evening wind-down after a day of adventures, we’re grateful to have been your go-to source for premium cannabis products . 
 
 Capturing Summer in Every Experience 
 As we move into September, the pace of life on the Cape begins to slow. The crowds thin out, and there’s a peacefulness that takes over as the leaves start to turn. But just because summer is ending doesn’t mean the fun has to stop. In fact, this is the perfect time to savor the last few warm days and create lasting memories. 
 
 Whatever your adventure bring along a Cape Cod Cannabis pre-roll or vape to enhance the experience (responsibly and within the law as always), allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the sights, sounds, and smells of the ocean. If you’re planning a weekend getaway, consider trying one of our edibles , tinctures or flower selections or a relaxing evening under the stars. And for those who enjoy a creative outlet, our sativa strains can be just the thing to inspire a late-summer painting session, journaling, or even just a reflective walk in nature. 
 
 Transitioning into Autumn with Cape Cod Cannabis 
 As we transition into the fall, there’s a certain coziness that comes with the season. It’s a time for warm sweaters, hot drinks, and gathering with friends around a bonfire (perhaps wearing something from our signature Cape Cod Cannabis apparel collection to keep you warm and cozy). And it’s also a time when many of us like to slow down and focus on self-care. At Cape Cod Cannabis, we’re here to help you make the most of this shift with products that are perfect for unwinding after a long day or enjoying a quiet evening at home. 
 
 Our selection of indica strains , for example, is ideal for those looking to relax and de-stress as the temperatures drop. Pair them with a good book or a movie, and you’ve got the recipe for a perfect fall evening. And for those who want to stay active and engaged, our hybrid options offer a balanced experience that can keep you motivated without feeling overwhelmed. We also offer a great selection of CBD products that may help relieve aches and pains, stress, and anxiety or help with getting a better night’s sleep. 
 
 A Heartfelt Thank You to Our Community 
 As we bid farewell to another summer, we want to take a moment to express our gratitude to the Cape Cod community. We love being a part of your summer adventures, and we’re honored that you’ve chosen Cape Cod Cannabis as your trusted source for quality cannabis products . Whether you’re a local resident or a visitor who discovered us during your travels, we appreciate your support and look forward to serving you in the seasons to come. 
 
 Summer may be coming to an end, but there’s still so much to look forward to on Cape Cod. The beauty of the Cape in the fall is something truly special—quieter, more intimate, but just as stunning. And as always, we’re here to enhance your experience, no matter the season. 
 
 Thank you for being a part of our community. Here’s to the end of a fantastic summer and the beginning of an equally wonderful autumn. We can’t wait to see what the next season brings! 
 
 Stay warm, stay cozy, and stay connected with Cape Cod Cannabis…it’s worth the trip! 
 
 With gratitude, 
 The Cape Cod Cannabis Team

 End of Summer on Cape Cod 2026 & Why September is one of the best times to visit

 
 
 
 
 
 August 17, 2026 
 
 

 Home / Cape Cod Lifestyle / End of Summer on Cape Cod 2026 & Why September is one of the best times to visit 
 

 End of Summer on Cape Cod 2026: Why September Is One of the Best Times to Visit
 Summer may be winding down, but Cape Cod is far from finished .
 
 For many people who know and love the Cape, late August and September are some of the best weeks of the entire year. The beaches are still calling, the restaurants and local businesses are welcoming visitors, outdoor adventures continue, and the Outer Cape begins settling into a slightly slower rhythm.
 
 Whether you are squeezing in one last Cape Cod vacation, visiting for Labor Day Weekend , or lucky enough to call the Cape home, there is still plenty of summer left to enjoy.
 
 At Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet , we love this time of year. It is a chance to enjoy everything that makes summer on Cape Cod special while looking forward to the quieter beauty of fall.
 
 Is September a Good Time to Visit Cape Cod?
 Absolutely.
 
 September offers a different Cape Cod experience than the peak weeks of July and August. Summer does not suddenly disappear after Labor Day. Beaches, trails, restaurants, shops, galleries, live music, and outdoor activities continue throughout the Outer Cape.
 
 The Cape Cod National Seashore is open year round, and June through September are among its most popular months. Many visitor facilities and programs also continue through the summer season.
 
 That makes late summer a great time to explore Wellfleet, Eastham, Truro, Provincetown, Orleans, and the rest of the Outer Cape.
 
 Enjoy One More Cape Cod Beach Day
 There is something special about a late summer beach day on Cape Cod.
 
 Spend the afternoon along the Atlantic, walk the shoreline, watch the waves, or simply find a quiet spot and enjoy the view.
 
 Wellfleet offers easy access to some of the Cape’s most beautiful natural areas, including the beaches and trails of the Cape Cod National Seashore .
 
 September can also be a wonderful time to explore the Cape on foot. Walking trails, salt marshes, dunes, ponds, and coastal landscapes provide plenty of reasons to stay outside even as the calendar begins moving toward fall.
 
 Explore Wellfleet Beyond the Beach
 A trip to Wellfleet does not have to begin and end at the beach.
 
 Walk around town, visit the galleries, enjoy fresh seafood, explore Wellfleet Harbor, take a bike ride, or spend an afternoon discovering the natural beauty of the Outer Cape.
 
 The slower pace of late summer can make it easier to appreciate the things that sometimes get overlooked during the busiest weeks of the season.
 
 It is one of the reasons we love being part of the Wellfleet community.
 
 Labor Day Weekend Means Live Music in Wellfleet
 Labor Day Weekend 2026 brings another reason to visit Wellfleet.
 
 The 4th Annual Outer Cape Music Festival returns to Wellfleet Town Pier on September 5 and 6, 2026 , bringing two days of live music, waterfront views, community, and charitable giving.
 
 The 2026 lineup includes Electric Six, Baha Men, Crooked Coast, 40 Thieves & Friends, The Boston Naturals, Natalia Bonfini Band, Club 9 Ball, Bar Maids, Watch Your Step, Matthew E. Devlin, and Kami Lyle and Friends featuring Joey and Johnny Spampinato, Barbara Blazedell and Tim Utt .
 
 Even better, the festival uses music to give back to organizations serving Cape Cod and beyond.
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis is proud to sponsor the 2026 Outer Cape Music Festival and support an event that brings visitors, residents, musicians, businesses, and charitable organizations together for Labor Day Weekend.
 
 If you are heading to the festival, make a day of it and experience everything Wellfleet has to offer.
 
 Visit Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet
 If you are searching for a dispensary near me , a dispensary in Wellfleet , or a recreational cannabis dispensary while visiting the Outer Cape, stop by Cape Cod Cannabis .
 
 Located at 1446 Route 6 in South Wellfleet , Cape Cod Cannabis offers a large selection of cannabis and CBD products for adults 21 and older.
 
 Explore: 
 Cannabis flower 

 Pre-rolls 

 Edibles 

 Concentrates 

 Vape products 

 Tinctures 

 Topicals 

 CBD 

 Cannabis seeds 

 Accessories 

 Apparel 
 
 Not sure what you are looking for? Ask us. 
 
 We believe cannabis education should be easy to understand. Our team can explain different product types, cannabinoids, THC, CBD, terpenes, consumption methods, and other cannabis basics so you can make a more informed decision.
 
 Cannabis and Your Cape Cod Vacation
 If cannabis is part of your Cape Cod vacation, a little planning goes a long way.
 
 Massachusetts allows recreational cannabis purchases by adults who are 21 or older (with a VALID ID) , but where cannabis can be consumed is restricted.
 
 Cannabis should not be consumed in public places, on Cape Cod beaches, at the Outer Cape Music Festival, or while driving. Cannabis also cannot legally be transported across state lines.
 
 Purchase from a licensed Massachusetts dispensary, understand the products you choose, consume responsibly in a location where consumption is permitted, and never drive while impaired.
 
 Summer Is Not Over Just Because Labor Day Arrives
 Labor Day may be called the unofficial end of summer, but Cape Cod has never paid much attention to the calendar.
 
 There are still sunsets to watch.
 Beaches to walk.
 Trails to explore.
 Seafood to enjoy.
 Music to hear.
 Local businesses to discover.
 And memories to make…
 Discover Wellfleet 
 
 For many Cape Cod regulars, this is exactly when the Cape becomes especially enjoyable.
 
 Experience Late Summer on the Outer Cape
 If you have been thinking about taking one more Cape Cod trip before fall, consider this your invitation.
 
 Spend the morning exploring the Cape Cod National Seashore. Grab lunch in Wellfleet. Discover a local gallery or shop. Catch the Outer Cape Music Festival during Labor Day Weekend. Watch the sunset. Slow down and enjoy the Outer Cape.
 
 And if your plans include visiting a recreational dispensary, stop by Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet .
 
 Whether it is your first visit or you have been coming to see us all summer, we are happy to be part of your Cape Cod experience.
 
 Summer may be winding down, but there is still plenty of Cape Cod left to enjoy.

Bertha is Back!! Pop-Up

 
 June 14, 2024 
 
@ 3:00 pm 
- 7:00 pm 

 
 

 
 
 Bertha is back!!! Experience their music, games, chance to chill, free giveaways, and merchandise for sale. Holistic Industries will have brand ambassadors available to educate you on Garcia Hand Picked products too! 
 
 THEIR STORY
 Given a blank space to create a cannabis brand worthy of Jerry, we picked everything carefully. We took an eco-friendly path whenever possible, sourced original and unique genetics with stories of their own, and partnered with expert and honorable people to cultivate, roll joints, and make sure everything is of the highest quality. We spent a lot of time looking for the right partners to ensure our weed is worth sharing. Our traveling Airstream, Bertha, continues to crisscross the country spreading her magic and bliss. She’s filled with merch and music and has become a beloved ambassador of Garcia Hand Picked.
 
 Set intention for a good time, pick a favorite show, and share with your tribe what thousands of fans have already discovered: the transcendent experience of cannabis and music. Expand your mind and remember that life is yours to explore and enjoy.
 
 Jerry was a musician, an artist, a legend, and for sure, someone who opted for fun in his lifetime. That is our hope for you. Take a moment to reconnect with everything that is beautiful, right, and good, and above all else, don’t forget to have fun!
 
 With gratitude from our family to yours,

The Garcia Family
 
 
 
 
 CLASSIC FLOWER

 Inspired by old-school lot strains, Garcia Hand Picked cultivars like Florida Kush and LA Baker are becoming big hits with cannabis lovers.

 
 JERRY’S PICKS

 Modeled after Jerry’s guitar picks, Jerry’s Picks are tasty, all-natural, and terpene infused for a natural effect. With blueberry, raspberry, blackberry and 10 mg of THC artfully blended together, fun is highly likely.
 

 DOUBLE DOOBIE

 Imagine two joints where you thought there might be one, introducing Double Doobie. Same cultivars you’ve come to love, now in a two-half gram joint package. More joints, more bridges.

 
 ROADIE PACK

 Ten packs of quality pre-rolled joints are now available in eco-friendly packs made for passing and sharing.

 Boards in the Stores 2026 Returns to Cape Cod: Support Local Artists, Local Business, and the Orleans Chamber of Commerce
 Summer on Cape Cod is about more than beaches, sunsets, and oysters. It is also a time to celebrate the creativity, community, and local businesses that make the Cape such a special place to live and visit. One of the most anticipated community events each summer is the Boards in the Stores 2026 Online Auction , hosted annually by the Orleans Chamber of Commerce .
 
 Beginning June 5, 2026 , and running through August 19, 2026 , this unique fundraising event brings together local artists and local businesses to create one of the most exciting online auctions on Cape Cod. This year, Cape Cod Cannabis is proud to once again participate as a sponsor.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What Is Boards in the Stores?
 Boards in the Stores is a Cape Cod tradition that combines art, community, and philanthropy.
 
 The concept is simple. Local businesses sponsor a surfboard shaped art board and partner with a local artist who transforms it into a one of a kind work of art. Each board is then featured in the online auction where community members, visitors, collectors, and supporters can place bids throughout the summer.
 
 Every board tells a story and showcases the incredible talent found throughout Cape Cod. The result is a gallery of creative pieces inspired by the Cape’s natural beauty, culture, wildlife, and coastal lifestyle.
 
 
 
 
 Supporting the Orleans Chamber and Local Artists
 One of the reasons Boards in the Stores has become such a beloved event is that it directly benefits both the community and the artists involved.
 
 50 Percent of Proceeds Support the Orleans Chamber of Commerce
 The Orleans Chamber of Commerce works year round to promote local businesses, support economic development, and strengthen the communities of the Lower and Outer Cape. Funds raised through the auction help support programs, events, and initiatives that benefit residents, visitors, and businesses alike.
 
 50 Percent of Proceeds Go Directly to the Artist
 Artists are the heart of this event. Each board represents countless hours of creativity, craftsmanship, and passion. By participating in the auction, bidders are directly supporting local Cape Cod artists while also investing in a unique piece of coastal art. It is truly a win for everyone involved.

 Curious about the Boutiq SWITCH™? We carry the 2g TRIO V5 disposable, which lets you choose among three strains in one device. Our team can help you learn more while you’re here.
 
 
 Featuring cutting-edge dual chamber technology, Boutiq SWITCH™ offers three distinct strains in a single sleek device that can be hit individually, or both at once. BOUTIQ™ Oil is a blend of pure Liquid Live Diamonds and expertly curated Terpenes.
 
 
 
 The SWITCH™ interface allows users to seamlessly alternate between strains or blend them together, offering a personalized experience unlike anything before it. Its integrated display clearly indicates strain selection, battery life, and Blinker Count™—delivering a vaping ritual that’s interactive, refined, and uniquely personal.
 
 The BOUTIQ SWITCH™ delivers cannabis exactly as it should be: iconic, intentional, and unmatched.

Boutiq “Spooky” Pop-Up Event

 
 October 31, 2025 
 
@ 4:00 pm 
- 7:00 pm 

 
 

 Wear your favorite “Halloweed” costume and learn about the Boutiq brand and their products before your night on the town.
 
 We currently carry their SWITCH™ Liquid Diamond – 2 Flavor / Strain – 2g Dual Disposables that are a fan favorite.
 
 Featuring cutting-edge dual chamber technology, SWITCH™ offers two distinct strains in a single sleek device that can be hit individually, or both at once. BOUTIQ™ Oil is a blend of pure Liquid Live Diamonds and expertly curated Terpenes.
 
 The SWITCH™ interface allows users to seamlessly alternate between strains or blend them together, offering a personalized experience unlike anything before it. Its integrated display clearly indicates strain selection, battery life, and Blinker Count™—delivering a vaping ritual that’s interactive, refined, and uniquely personal.
 
 The BOUTIQ SWITCH™ delivers cannabis exactly as it should be: iconic, intentional, and unmatched.
 
 
 
 
 
 Click here to shop Boutiq SWITCH™ Dual Disposables!

 Learn more about Chill Medicated topical and tincture products, and the potential benefits. 
 
 Let’s face it, we all have our issues. Providing you with reliable relief so that you can live your best life is what we’re really here to do, that’s why Chill chooses you. Being able to do something you are passionate about is something that not many individuals get the chance to do; making it that much easier for us to prioritize quality and consistency.
 
 Find reliable relief where it matters most. Pain may be inevitable but suffering is not! Their topical is non-transdermal, meaning it does not get you high, making it the perfect fit for all day use in any environment.
 
 Recommended Uses: Muscle Soreness, Pain, Tension, Stress, Inflammation, Cramping, Skin Conditions, Muscle Strain, Arthritis, Nerve Damage, Nausea, Psoriasis, Dermatitis, Headaches, Migraines, Sunburns, Scar Tissue Repair and more.
 
 Searching for the perfect complement to your favorite beverage? Look no further. Take one teaspoon and ingest under the tongue or dilute with your choice of soda, water, or other beverages. You can also add it to your favorite ice cream or your favorite meal!

Coast Cannabis Pop-Up Event

 
 August 20, 2026 
 
@ 2:00 pm 
- 4:00 pm 

 
 

 Learn more about Coast Cannabis Co. products (Infused Gummies & Chocolates and Vaporizer Carts) and enjoy some of their non-infused, delicious gummies and/or chocolates on Thursday August 20, 2026 from 2pm – 4pm! 
 Coast Cannabis Co. is on a mission to make feeling good feel good because, for us, cannabis is a wellness tool that should help you be your best self. But unfortunately, all the additives and junk that often come with it can make it anything but healthy. At Coast Cannabis Co., we craft quality products to give our customers the cannabis we wanted to see in the world.
 
 
 
 They are making sure everything that goes into their products is something they’d be proud to put into their bodies. That means using only high-quality, natural, artisanal ingredients, with no artificial dyes or colorings. But beyond that, we’re also sourcing conscientiously: Choosing fair trade, ethically grown ingredients because they’re better for you and the world around you.

 Pure Extraction: Utilizing proprietary, manually operated supercritical CO₂ extraction to lock in full-spectrum cannabinoids and authentic terpene profiles.

We took an eco-friendly path whenever possible, sourced original and unique genetics with stories of their own, and partnered with expert and honorable people to cultivate, roll joints, and make sure everything is of the highest quality. We spent a lot of time looking for the right partners to ensure our weed is worth sharing. Our traveling Airstream, Bertha, continues to crisscross the country spreading her magic and bliss. She’s filled with merch and music and has become a beloved ambassador of Garcia Hand Picked.
 
 Set intention for a good time, pick a favorite show, and share with your tribe what thousands of fans have already discovered: the transcendent experience of cannabis and music. Expand your mind and remember that life is yours to explore and enjoy.
 
 Jerry was a musician, an artist, a legend, and for sure, someone who opted for fun in his lifetime. That is our hope for you. Take a moment to reconnect with everything that is beautiful, right, and good, and above all else, don’t forget to have fun!
 
 With gratitude from our family to yours,

The Garcia Family
 
 Hand-Picked Cannabis 

 Worthy of a Legend. 
 
 
 https://capecodcannabis.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/GHP_Spinning_Cultivars.mp4 

 
 
 
 
 CLASSIC FLOWER

 Inspired by old-school lot strains, Garcia Hand Picked cultivars like Florida Kush and LA Baker are becoming big hits with cannabis lovers.

 
 JERRY’S PICKS

 Modeled after Jerry’s guitar picks, Jerry’s Picks are tasty, all-natural, and terpene infused for a natural effect. With blueberry, raspberry, blackberry and 10 mg of THC artfully blended together, fun is highly likely.

 
 DOUBLE DOOBIE

 Imagine two joints where you thought there might be one, introducing Double Doobie. Same cultivars you’ve come to love, now in a two-half gram joint package. More joints, more bridges.

 
 ROADIE PACK

 Ten packs of quality pre-rolled joints are now available in ecofriendly packs made for passing and sharing.
 

 TOUR PACK

 The Garcia Hand Picked Tour Pack was made for life on tour in an easy to pack, easy to share resealable bag.

HAVN & Stingers Pop-Up Event

 
 April 17, 2026 
 
@ 4:00 pm 
- 7:00 pm 

 
 

 Learn more about “two brands” products at one Pop-Up… 
 
 STINGERS
 From Boston to the Berkshires, Stingers brings big flavor and serious fire to the Bay State. Our Massachusetts lineup is all about craft, potency, and pure satisfaction — featuring full-flower infused pre-rolls, slow-burning blunts, and our newest flavor-driven innovation, SWEETS by Stingers.
 
 Each product is handcrafted using premium full flower, and high-grade cannabis extracts for smooth, flavorful, and reliable potency. Whether you’re rolling through Worcester or chilling on the Cape, Stingers delivers flavor you can taste and strength you can trust.
 
 Click here to shop Stingers products 
 
 
 
 
 HAVN EXTRACTS IS A CRAFT CANNABIS COMPANY
 All of us at HAVN Extracts love what we do, and are working daily to provide our customers with innovative, pure and natural products! High quality inputs yield high quality outputs is the philosophy that guides us. All of our products are made not just with the best cannabis, but premium, all natural ingredients as well.
 
 Whether you’re using HAVN products for sleep assistance, pain management, or just for pleasure, we thank you for placing your trust in us!
 
 Click here to shop HAVN products

 June 27, 2026 
 
@ 12:00 pm 
- 2:00 pm 

 
 

 Learn more about the Hellavated brand that offers great products, such as their Vape Cartridges, Infused Pre-Rolls, and more! 
 Kick it into HIGH gear. Juicy Stickz combines whole bud flower with our proprietary infusion of melted diamonds, botanical terpenes, and kief to create a potent flavor explosion, packaged expertly in a 0.75g pre-roll. You can expect a smooth, tasty burn all the way to the end that delivers on potency and is packed with flavor. Available in singles or 5-packs.
 
 Vapes will never be the same. Hellavated carts combine the unmatched potency of distillate with our unique hella-tasty natural terpene blends to deliver an out-of-this-world experience that is sure to make your mouth water. You can expect maximum flavor and a smooth and easy vaping experience no matter which Hellavated vape you pick for the day’s adventures.
 
 Be one of the FIRST 20 Hellavated fans at our exclusive Baja Blastoff Pop-Up and receive a STASH Can entry to WIN a $500 Taco Bell Gift Card! 
 No purchase necessary to enter. 
 NEW FLAVOR! LIMITED TIME DROP! 
 .

Whether you’re new to these brands or already a fan, it’s a great opportunity to expand your cannabis knowledge.
 
 Regenerative, LLC is a Massachusetts’ premier, licensed cannabis cultivator and manufacturer, based in Uxbridge.
 The name Regenerative stems from the pursuit of growing in true living soil also known as regenerative farming. As a result, the difference in the quality of their product cannot be understated – the combination of organic practices, sun-grown, and directly in soil is truly the way cannabis was meant to be grown.
 
 They offer high-quality, sustainably sun-grown cannabis products, proudly cultivating in our Tier 10 outdoor facility. They have 14 active hoop houses alongside our outdoor field in full bloom, and a product manufacturing lab. They take pride in our environmentally conscious techniques, growing in true organic soil.

Strane Pop-Up

 
 September 13, 2024 
 
@ 2:00 pm 
- 5:00 pm 

 
 

 Learn more about Strane, Garcia Hand Picked, Hellavated, and Do Drops brands and enjoy some of their non-infused samples! 
 
 Strane – Strane can be found in so many places and form factors and it all starts with the unique cultivars cannabis customers and budtenders love. Nature and nurture, Strane showcases our skill at growing craft cannabis at scale.
 
 Garcia Hand Picked – Trixie Garcia brainstormed with the team when we chose the name “hand picked”. Ever since we have collaborated with Garcia’s family to choose the strains, products, packages, merch, events, and charities worthy of a legend. It’s the most authentic and successful celebrity brand in the making.
 
 Hellavated – First introduced in Oregon, Hellavated and its flavor-forward, potent line of products are now growing quickly across our markets. Customers love the well-priced vapes, edibles and joints with fun flavors like Bomb Popz, Mango Dragon, and OG Mint.
 
 Do Drops – Introducing new DO Drops, the edible with all the feels including Relax, Focus, Sleep, Energy, Relief and Mild. DO Drops have been reformulated to meet the customer where they are with balanced cannabis ratios, enhancing effects, and transcendent flavors.
 
 
 Click here to shop Strane products!

 Cannabis-Infused Edibles for Every Adventure 
 Learn more about WYLD Brand cannabis sativa, indica, hybrid or CBD edibles and their many delicious flavors! 
 
 
 
 
 Click here to shop WYLD products! 
 
 
 About Wyld
 Wyld was founded in 2016 to create best-in-class cannabis edibles using real fruit and natural flavors. What began as three college friends over a two-burner stove in a tiny farm building in Central Oregon is now America’s best-selling cannabis gummy brand.
 
 The growth of Wyld from its humble beginnings to an international leader in the cannabis industry has been based on our commitment to quality, operational excellence, and direct partnership with our amazing community of retailers and budtenders. We have remained independent and progressive in our approach to growth, allowing us to maintain our stringent standards for product quality and business practices. We act with integrity and intensity to keep Wyld true to its origins.
 
 The popularity of Wyld has been built with flavors inspired by our love of nature, high quality ingredients, consistent dosing, and one goal in mind: to produce the best tasting edibles in the world. Wyld has also built a reputation for providing trustworthy, repeatable cannabis experiences which consumers can rely on. Not only do our gummies have great flavor, they are designed and continuously improved by our team of food scientists and quality experts. We proudly offer our best in every package of Wyld.
 
 Wyld gummies are made with real fruit ingredients and natural flavors for authentic, true-to-fruit flavor. Wyld gummies use cannabis extracts blended with unique botanical and fruit terpenes to craft our world class flavors, effects and experiences. Wyld products are designed and continuously improved by a team of food scientists who work daily to create our industry leading cannabis edibles. Our stringent manufacturing standards and quality controls ensure consistent dosing and flavor throughout every batch of product we produce. Wyld gummies contain THC, the psychoactive component of cannabis which is responsible for creating the “high” experienced when consuming cannabis products.

 Exploring Wellfleet, MA: A Hidden Gem on Cape Cod

 
 
 
 
 
 August 16, 2024 
 
 

 Home / Start Here / Exploring Wellfleet, MA: A Hidden Gem on Cape Cod 
 

 Nestled on the outer arm of Cape Cod, Wellfleet, MA , is a coastal haven that offers a perfect blend of natural beauty, rich history, and vibrant culture. Known for its pristine beaches, charming downtown, and world-famous oysters, Wellfleet is a must-visit destination for those seeking a quintessential Cape Cod experience.
 
 A Natural Paradise 
 One of the first things you’ll notice about Wellfleet is its stunning natural landscapes. The town is home to a large portion of the Cape Cod National Seashore , a protected area that encompasses miles of unspoiled beaches, salt marshes, and freshwater ponds. Whether you’re a beach lover, a hiker, or a birdwatcher, there’s something for everyone.
 
 Marconi Beach is a favorite spot for both locals and visitors alike. Named after the Italian inventor Guglielmo Marconi, who sent the first transatlantic wireless communication from this area, the beach offers breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean and towering sand dunes. It’s a great place to relax, take a refreshing swim, or catch some waves if you’re into surfing. If you prefer a quieter experience, Great Island Trail offers a serene escape into nature. This trail winds through forested areas, marshlands, and along the shoreline, providing opportunities to spot local wildlife and enjoy the peaceful surroundings.
 
 A Rich History 
 Wellfleet’s history is deeply rooted in the maritime industry. The town’s name is believed to be derived from “whale fleet,” as the area was once a bustling center for whaling and fishing. Today, you can still feel the town’s seafaring heritage through its historic landmarks and well-preserved architecture. One such landmark is the Wellfleet Historical Society & Museum , which offers a fascinating glimpse into the town’s past. The museum features exhibits on Wellfleet’s maritime history, Native American heritage, and the development of the local oyster industry.
 
 The World-Famous Wellfleet Oysters 
 Speaking of oysters, no trip to Wellfleet would be complete without indulging in some of the world’s finest shellfish. Wellfleet oysters are renowned for their clean, briny flavor and are considered among the best in the world. Whether you enjoy them raw, grilled, or in a classic New England chowder, the local restaurants serve up these delicacies in various mouthwatering ways. For a true taste of Wellfleet, visit the Wellfleet OysterFest , an annual event held every October that celebrates the town’s shellfishing traditions. The festival features oyster shucking contests, local food vendors, live music, and a bustling artisan market.
 
 A Vibrant Arts Community 
 Wellfleet is also known for its thriving arts scene. The town has long been a haven for artists, writers, and musicians, drawn by the natural beauty and tranquil atmosphere. The Wellfleet Harbor Actors Theater (WHAT) is a cultural cornerstone, offering a variety of performances from contemporary plays to classic productions. Art enthusiasts will also appreciate the numerous galleries that dot the town, showcasing works by local and regional artists. The Wellfleet Art Gallery Walk is a great way to explore these spaces and discover unique pieces of art.
 
 A Charming Downtown 
 Strolling through downtown Wellfleet is like stepping back in time. The town’s Main Street is lined with charming shops, cozy cafes, and historic buildings. Here, you can browse through antique stores, pick up a book at the local bookstore, or enjoy a cup of coffee at a quaint café. One of the highlights of downtown is the Wellfleet Preservation Hall , a beautifully restored historic building that serves as a community hub for events, workshops, and art exhibitions.
 
 A Perfect Cape Cod Escape 
 Whether you’re looking to soak up the sun on a beautiful beach, explore the town’s rich history, savor world-class oysters, or immerse yourself in the local arts scene, Wellfleet, MA, has something to offer every traveler. Its blend of natural beauty, cultural richness, and small-town charm makes it a true hidden gem on Cape Cod.
 
 So, if you’re planning a trip to Cape Cod, make sure to include Wellfleet in your itinerary and stop by Cape Cod Cannabis on Rt. 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza. You’ll discover a place that not only captures the essence of the Cape but also leaves you with memories that will last a lifetime.

FAQs from Cape Cod Cannabis

 Cannabis Dispensary located in Wellfleet, MA

 Welcome to Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary , your trusted source for the largest selection of premium cannabis products, at the best prices on Cape Cod, located in Wellfleet, Massachusetts.
 
 Whether you’re new to cannabis or a seasoned enthusiast, we’re here to answer all your questions. Our FAQs (frequently asked questions) covers the most common asked questions. At Cape Cod Cannabis, we’re dedicated to providing you with safe, high-quality products in a friendly and informative environment. Explore our FAQs to learn more about how we can serve your cannabis needs on Cape Cod!
 
 Visit us in the Rt 6. shopping plaza in South Wellfleet, MA and experience the difference… always worth the trip! Please contact us at (774) 383-3133 if you have further questions and weed be happy to assist.

 
 
 
 Shop Menu 
 
 

 Most FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions) 

 
 
 
 CLICK HERE TO VIEW FAQs
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Where is Cape Cod Cannabis located? 
 Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary is located at 1446 US-6, Wellfleet, MA 02667 . We’re conveniently located along Route 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza, designed like a rest stop, for easy entry and exit with plenty of free parking, includes a bakery, liquor store, and U.S. Post Office for your convenience. Click here for directions . 
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis is a licensed adult-use recreational dispensary serving residents and visitors alike in Barnstable , Bourne , Brewster , Chatham , Dennis , Eastham , Falmouth , Harwich , Hyannis , Mashpee , Orleans , Provincetown , Sandwich , Truro , Wellfleet , Yarmouth and beyond. 

 
 
 
 
 
 Where can I find weed near me on Cape Cod? 
 If you’re searching for weed near me on Cape Cod , Cape Cod Cannabis is an adult-use recreational dispensary located at 1446 US-6 in Wellfleet, Massachusetts , in the South Wellfleet area of the Outer Cape. We’re open daily and offer a wide selection of recreational cannabis products. Customers 21+ can shop in-store or order online for convenient pickup with valid ID.

 
 
 
 
 
 What is the legal age to purchase cannabis in Massachusetts? 
 We welcome anyone 21 years of age or older with a valid Government ID (e.g., Drivers License, Passport, etc.) to verify your age upon entry. Unfortunately, we cannot accept expired MA ID’s unless, when already renewed, you bring the expired MA ID with the actual MA RMV documentation for the renewal.
 
 Unfortunately, we cannot accept any out-of-state or International ID’s that are expired. 
 
 Note : We respect if you are wearing a mask when you enter but please know that, per regulations, we have to properly identify everyone who enters. You will be asked to momentarily remove (or lower) your mask for identification purposes. We thank you for your cooperation and understanding. 

 
 
 
 
 
 What should I expect when visiting a dispensary for the first time? 
 If it’s your first time visiting a dispensary in Massachusetts, the process is simple and welcoming. When you arrive, you’ll be asked to show a valid government-issued ID to confirm you are 21 or older. After check-in, you can browse the menu or speak with a knowledgeable staff member (often called a budtender) who can help you choose products based on your preferences and experience level.
 
 At Cape Cod Cannabis, you’ll find a variety of options including flower , pre-rolls , edibles , vapes , tinctures , topicals , CBD and concentrates . Our budtenders are here to answer questions and make recommendations, whether you’re looking to relax, sleep better, or try cannabis for the first time. Once you’ve made your selection, you’ll proceed to checkout—we accept cash and debit payment options. We also have an on-site ATM for your convenience.
 
 Overall, expect a safe, regulated, and educational experience designed to help you feel comfortable and informed…and NOT rushed.
 
 We also offer an online assistant (bottom left side of the website) to ask questions and lead you in the right direction. Please give us a call at (774) 383-3133 if you have further questions.

 
 
 
 
 
 What do customers say about Cape Cod Cannabis? 
 
 2026 Cape Cod Choice Awards: Best CBD Store Winner | Top 3 Best Cannabis Dispensary 
 Customers frequently mention our knowledgeable and friendly team, wide cannabis selection, personalized service, welcoming atmosphere, convenient Route 6 location, and overall dispensary experience. Read our recent customer reviews to see feedback directly from customers.

 
 
 
 
 
 Can I leave a review for Cape Cod Cannabis? 
 Yes. Visit our Leave Your Review page to share your experience on Google or Yelp.

 
 
 
 
 
 What are the operating hours for Cape Cod Cannabis? 
 We’re open 7 days a week. Please check our hours for the most up-to-date hours, including holiday schedules.

 
 
 
 
 
 What cannabis products do you carry? 
 Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary in Wellfleet offers the largest selection of quality flower , pre-rolls , seeds , edibles , vapes , concentrates , syrups / tinctures , CBD , topicals , pet drops and more at the BEST prices on Cape Cod…something for every preference and experience level. Always worth the trip! 

 
 
 
 
 
 Is there a limit to how much cannabis I can buy? 
 Yes. As of April 19, 2026 , Massachusetts law allows you to purchase up to 2 ounces of flower (Recreational) or its equivalent in other cannabis products per day.
 
 Click here to visit our “Understanding the Daily Purchase Limit in MA” page for more information and to calculate your daily purchase.
 
 Recreational = 56 grams (flower) a day is the legal MA limit, which can constitute: 
 
 • Flower : Up to 56 grams (2 ounces).
 • Edibles : A total of 10 00mg THC , which is roughly 10 packs of 20 servings , each serving containing 5mg of THC .
 • Concentrates : Up to 10 grams of cannabis concentrates, such as wax, shatter, or live resin (equivalent to 10 x 1g or 20 x 0.5g packages).
 • Tinctures : A total of 10000mg = approximately 10 x 1000mg bottles , depending on the product’s potency and total THC content.
 • Pre-roll Joints : 56 pre-roll joints , assuming each joint contains roughly 1 gram of flower .
 • Vape Cartridges : Up to 20 x 0.5g cartridges or 10 x 1g cartridges/disposables .
 
 CBD = No Limit 
 Topicals = No Limit 
 Accessories = No Limit 

 
 
 
 
 
 Are your cannabis products tested for safety and quality? 
 Yes. Cannabis products sold at Cape Cod Cannabis are required to meet Massachusetts testing and labeling requirements before being offered for retail sale.

 
 
 
 
 
 What payment methods are accepted? 
 We accept cash, debit cards and CanPay . A regular ATM is also located on-site for your convenience.
 
 Note : ATM and Debit transactions will incur a small third-party merchant fee. 

 
 
 
 
 
 Do you offer online ordering or pre-orders? 
 Yes! Browse our full menu online or our Daily Offers page and place a pre-order for quick and easy pickup in-store.
 
 Once you finalize your order, it will be filled within 15 minutes and you will be able to pick it up at the store. Changes to pre-orders can be made during checkout at the store.
 
 PLEASE double check your phone number when entering your pre-order. 
 
 We will not keep orders placed, past our store closing, the day of when the order was placed.

 
 
 
 
 
 What should I know about cannabis? 
 For a quick overview of the different types of cannabis products, terpenes, cannabinoids, strains and more please visit Intro to Cannabis 101 .

 
 
 
 
 
 Do you offer a Loyalty Program? 
 Yes! We do offer a FREE Loyalty VIP Program where you can accumulate points that will be generated automatically and tracked for you for redemption.
 
 NOTE : Per MA Cannabis Control Commission regulations, Loyalty Points CANNOT be used for cannabis products . 
 
 Currently, y ou CAN use your Loyalty Points toward Cape Cod Cannabis CBD, Accessories or Merch only. 
 
 As soon as the CCC ( Cannabis Control Commission ) will approve or will remove the limitations on the promotions, you will be able to use these points toward all Cape Cod Cannabis products. That way you will not miss out on any points you could have accumulated if there were no limitations to begin with. In the meantime, you will get access to the VIP program.
 
 Not a Loyalty Program VIP member? JOIN FOR FREE IN-STORE TODAY! 
 
 Already a Loyalty Program VIP member? Click here to Shop your Loyalty VIP Points. 

 
 
 
 
 
 What is your Return Policy? 
 Cape Cod Cannabis is committed to customer satisfaction when it comes to the products we sell.
 
 RETURN POLICY 
 Please visit our Return Policy page for more information.
 
 CONTACT US 
 If you have any questions regarding our Return Policy please contact us or call (774) 383-3133.

 
 
 
 
 
 What is your Privacy Policy? 
 PRIVACY POLICY 
 Please visit our Privacy Policy page for more information.
 
 CONTACT US 
 If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy please contact us or call us at (774) 383-3133.

 
 
 
 
 
 Do you ship your Apparel? 
 Yes! Our apparel, hats, beanies, sweatshirts, joggers and more can be shipped to you (within the United States only) via USPS Priority. Please visit our online store Blue Tail Apparel & Merch @ www.BlueTail.cc for convenient, safe and easy shopping and we will ship your order to you!
 
 Of course, you can always pre-order Cape Cod Cannabis apparel , accessories and merch for local pickup.
 
 * Please note : Loyalty Points do not apply for purchases on BlueTail.cc at this time. 
 
 In-store or pre-order (non-cannabis) purchases on CapeCodCannabis.com are applicable using your Loyalty Points.

 FREE Bar Coasters from Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary 

 FREE Coasters for Cape Cod Bars & Restaurants
 You Pour the Drinks. We’ll Supply the Coasters.
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis offers free bar coasters for restaurants, bars and hospitality businesses throughout Cape Cod. Our professionally designed coasters are complimentary, delivered directly to participating establishments and available at no cost to your business. We currently deliver our coasters to many restaurants on Cape Cod …and they LOVE them! 
 
 Our professionally designed coasters feature Cape Cod coastal imagery, Wellfleet branding and responsible adult-use messaging while providing a practical coaster for your tables and bar service — at absolutely no cost to your business. 
 
 We’ll even deliver them directly to you. Or you can stop by and pick them up (based on availability). 
 
 FREE COASTERS • FREE DELIVERY • NO COST TO PARTICIPATE 

 
 
 

 The Coaster Program in a Nutshell 
 Program Details Free coasters, delivered right to your business. Cape Cod Cannabis keeps participating Cape Cod restaurants, bars and hospitality businesses stocked throughout the year, including key holiday weekends and special local events. 
 Program Cape Cod Cannabis Coaster Program 
 Cost Free 
 Who Cape Cod restaurants, bars & hospitality businesses, etc. 
 Delivery Complimentary 
 Scheduled Deliveries Approx. 4 times per year (in addition to local events) 
 Typical Delivery Periods Memorial Day, Fourth of July, Labor Day, Wellfleet OysterFest 
 Additional Deliveries Based on availability 
 Service Area Upper Cape, Mid Cape, Lower Cape, Outer Cape (Cape Cod, MA) 
 

 
 2026 Cape Cod Choice Awards: Best CBD Store Winner | Top 3 Best Cannabis Dispensary 

 
 

 Free Coaster Delivery 
 No cost. No pickup. No hassle. 
 
 This isn’t a one-time giveaway. Cape Cod Cannabis will deliver a fresh supply of complimentary coasters to participating establishments four times each year , timed around some of Cape Cod’s busiest weekends: 
 
 Memorial Day Weekend • Fourth of July • Labor Day Weekend • Wellfleet Oyster Fest 
 
 We’ll coordinate delivery directly to your establishment, so there’s no need to pick them up or remember to reorder before these key holiday weekends. 
 
 Hosting a special local event or running low between deliveries? 
 Additional coasters and deliveries available upon request. (based on availability) 
 

 Get Free Coasters for Your Business
 
 The Cape Cod Cannabis Hospitality Coaster Program is available to appropriate restaurants, bars and hospitality establishments throughout Cape Cod.
 
 Getting started is easy. Tell us about your business and approximately how many coasters you typically need. Our team will contact you to confirm participation, quantities and delivery details.
 
 We welcome establishments throughout Wellfleet, Eastham, Truro, Provincetown, Orleans, Brewster, Chatham, Harwich, Dennis, Yarmouth, Hyannis and other Cape Cod communities. 
 
 Ready to get started? 
 Questions? Call Jim at (774) 383-3133 or click the button below to contact us via our online form. 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 Request Coasters / More Info 
 
 

 Coaster Program Disclaimer: Complimentary coasters are available to participating businesses at the discretion of Cape Cod Cannabis and while supplies last. Quantities, delivery schedules and additional deliveries may vary based on availability. Participation may be modified or discontinued at any time. Coasters are intended for appropriate adult oriented environments. For adults 21+ only. Please consume responsibly.
 Disclaimer | #MR282685 

 
 
 
 Check out our FREE Rack Cards Program 
 
 

 
 
 
 ABOUT CAPE COD CANNABIS
 
 
 
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary Near Me in Wellfleet, MA 
 Looking for the best Cape Cod dispensary near me? Visit Cape Cod Cannabis , located at 1446 US-6, Wellfleet, MA 02667, just minutes from downtown Wellfleet and right off Route 6 in South Wellfleet’s shopping plaza. We proudly serve both local Cape Cod residents and seasonal visitors with a wide selection of premium cannabis products , at the best prices on Cape Cod, knowledgeable and friendly service… and a cool vibe! 
 
 High-Quality Cannabis Products on Cape Cod 
 Whether you’re new to cannabis or a seasoned consumer, our knowledgeable team is here to help you choose the right product for your needs.
 
 Explore our robust menu, including:
 
 Exclusive Blazing Bargains & Bundles 
 Premium flower 

 Pre-Rolls / Infused Pre-Rolls 
 Cannabis Seeds 
 Edibles and cannabis beverages 

 THC Tinctures / Syrups 

 Vaporizers 

 Topicals for pain relief and skincare 

 CBD-only options 

 Concentrates 
 Smoking accessories and branded merchandise 

 Branded Apparel 
 
 We’re committed to making your experience easy, informative, and enjoyable, with no pressure, just helpful advice from a local team that knows cannabis.
 
 A Convenient Stop for Cape Cod Locals and Visitors 
 Conveniently located on Route 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza, Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary is an easy stop for anyone traveling to or from Provincetown, Eastham, Wellfleet, Truro, Orleans, Brewster, Hyannis or just off Cape in Plymouth. It’s a beautiful drive and…it’s worth the trip! Whether you’re exploring the Cape’s beaches, biking the Rail Trail, or heading back from a day at the National Seashore, our dispensary is a quick and convenient stop for all your cannabis needs.
 
 Why Cape Cod Cannabis? 
 Customers searching for a “dispensary near me” , “Cape Cod cannabis store” or “best dispensary on Cape Cod” consistently choose us for:
 
 The largest selection of quality cannabis products at the best prices on Cape Cod
 Trusted, lab-tested cannabis from top Massachusetts brands

 Transparent pricing and rotating promotions

 A clean, welcoming, and modern shopping experience

 Friendly and knowledgeable budtenders who offer personalized recommendations

 A true local feel with Cape Cod vibes

 
 Whether you’re seeking relaxation, creativity, relief, or just looking to try something new, we’ve got something for everyone, backed by customer-first service and deep local knowledge .
 
 Visit “what our customers say is” the Best Cannabis Dispensary on Cape Cod 
 Cape Cod Cannabis is more than a Wellfleet dispensary…we’re a destination. Locals and visitors alike rely on us for quality cannabis, honest guidance, and a smooth shopping experience. Stop by today and see why we’re consistently rated as the best dispensary in Wellfleet, MA , and one of the top cannabis spots on Cape Cod.
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary…Always worth the trip! 

 

 
 
 
 CLICK TO VIEW FAQ'S
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Are the coasters really free?
 
 
 
 
 Yes. There is no charge for participating establishments to receive or use the complimentary Cape Cod Cannabis coasters.

 
 
 
 How often will you deliver coasters?
 
 
 
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis plans three deliveries each year, typically before Memorial Day Weekend, the Fourth of July and Labor Day Weekend . Additional deliveries may be available for special local events or when more coasters are needed, based on availability.

 
 
 
 Do we have to pick them up?
 
 
 
 
 No. We’ll coordinate delivery directly to participating Cape Cod restaurants, bars and hospitality businesses.
 But you can visit Cape Cod Cannabis and check us out, if you haven’t been here before. Note: Visitors must be 21+ years of age with a valid government-issued ID.

 
 
 
 What if we need more coasters?
 
 
 
 
 Just contact Jim @ (774) 383-3133 to schedule. Additional coasters may be available between scheduled deliveries while supplies last (based on availability)!

Trusted by Cape Codders and visitors since 2021. 
 Easy to find and convenient to visit, Cape Cod Cannabis is located on Route 6 in the South Wellfleet Shopping Plaza , making us an easy stop for anyone looking for a recreational cannabis dispensary on Cape Cod . Whether you’re coming from Eastham, Truro, Provincetown, Orleans, Brewster, Yarmouth, Plymouth, or exploring Cape Cod on vacation, our convenient Route 6 location offers ample free parking and a streamlined check-in process for a smooth, welcoming, and stress-free dispensary experience.

Home / FREE Rack Card Program 
 

 FREE Rack Cards from Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary 

 Free Educational Rack Cards for Cape Cod Businesses
 Helpful Cannabis Information for Cape Cod Residents & Visitors
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis provides complimentary educational rack cards to participating Cape Cod businesses, lodging properties, visitor destinations and hospitality establishments .
 
 Our professionally designed rack cards provide adults 21+ with helpful information about recreational cannabis, responsible consumption, visiting a Massachusetts dispensary and Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet.
 
 There is no cost to participating businesses , and we’ll deliver the rack cards directly to your location.
 
 FREE RACK CARDS • FREE DELIVERY • NO COST TO PARTICIPATE 

 
 
 

 Cannabis Education Made Easy
 Program Details FreeComplimentary educational rack cards for Cape Cod businesses, providing adults 21+ with clear, easy to understand cannabis information. 
 Program Cape Cod Educational Rack Card Program 
 Cost Free 
 Who Cape Cod businesses, Lodging & Accommodations, Hospitality, Visitor Centers, Council on Aging, Senior Living facilities, etc. 
 Delivery Complimentary 
 Scheduled Deliveries As needed and based on availability 
 Additional Deliveries Available based on availability 
 Service Area Upper Cape, Mid Cape, Lower Cape, Outer Cape (Cape Cod, MA) 
 

 
 2026 Cape Cod Choice Awards: Best CBD Store Winner | Top 3 Best Cannabis Dispensary 

 
 

 Educational Information for Your Guests
 A Helpful Resource for Adults Visiting Cape Cod
 
 Cape Cod welcomes visitors from across Massachusetts and around the country, and many have questions about purchasing and consuming recreational cannabis while they’re here. 
 
 Our educational rack cards provide an easy resource for adults 21+ who want to learn more about Massachusetts cannabis rules, responsible consumption, recreational dispensary shopping and Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet. 
 
 Participating businesses can place the cards in appropriate locations such as: 
 Hotel and motel information displays, guest areas, visitor centers, concierge areas, restaurants, bars, vacation rental offices, entertainment venues and other adult-appropriate locations. 
 
 Educational. Local. Complimentary. 

 We’ll Deliver Them to You
 Join the Cape Cod Cannabis Rack Card Program
 Getting started is easy. Tell us about your business and approximately how many rack cards you’d like to display.
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis will coordinate delivery directly to participating businesses throughout Cape Cod and can provide additional cards when needed, based on availability.
 
 We welcome appropriate businesses and organizations throughout Wellfleet, Eastham, Truro, Provincetown, Orleans, Brewster, Chatham, Harwich, Dennis, Yarmouth, Hyannis and other Cape Cod communities. 
 
 Ready to get started? 
 Questions? Call Jim at (774) 383-3133 or click the button below to contact us via our online form. 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 Request Rack Cards / More Info 
 
 

 
 
 

 Cannabis 101 – Digital Edition
 The Complete Guide to Understanding Cannabis
 Whether you’re new to cannabis or looking to expand your knowledge, this guide provides clear, reliable, and easy-to-understand information to help you make informed decisions. Inside, you’ll learn about cannabis basics, cannabinoids, terpenes, product types, dosage, safety, and responsible consumption—all in a beginner-friendly format. 

 At Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet, we believe education builds confidence. There is a ton of information here, so take your time and let us know any other questions you might have. We hope this guide becomes a trusted resource as you continue your cannabis journey. 

 Features: Digital Edition (feel free to link to our guide and/or share) 
 QR Code to order ahead for easy pickup. 
 
 Clickable links include Table of Contents Page names 
 Underlined text 
 Cape Cod Cannabis logo, images, and social icons. 
 Flip page effect 
 

 
 Learn. Explore. Understand.

 
 
 
 View Cannabis 101 Digital Edition 
 
 

 Rack Card Program Disclaimer: Complimentary educational rack cards are available to participating businesses at the discretion of Cape Cod Cannabis and while supplies last. Quantities, delivery schedules and availability may vary. Participation may be modified or discontinued at any time. Materials are intended for appropriate locations and adults 21+ only. Please consume responsibly. | Disclaimer | #MR282685 

 
 
 
 Check out our FREE Bar Coasters Program 
 
 

 
 
 
 ABOUT CAPE COD CANNABIS
 
 
 
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary Near Me in Wellfleet, MA 
 Looking for the best Cape Cod dispensary near me? Visit Cape Cod Cannabis , located at 1446 US-6, Wellfleet, MA 02667, just minutes from downtown Wellfleet and right off Route 6 in South Wellfleet’s shopping plaza. We proudly serve both local Cape Cod residents and seasonal visitors with a wide selection of premium cannabis products , at the best prices on Cape Cod, knowledgeable and friendly service… and a cool vibe! 
 
 High-Quality Cannabis Products on Cape Cod 
 Whether you’re new to cannabis or a seasoned consumer, our knowledgeable team is here to help you choose the right product for your needs.
 
 Explore our robust menu, including:
 
 Exclusive Blazing Bargains & Bundles 
 Premium flower 

 Pre-Rolls / Infused Pre-Rolls 
 Cannabis Seeds 
 Edibles and cannabis beverages 

 THC Tinctures / Syrups 

 Vaporizers 

 Topicals for pain relief and skincare 

 CBD-only options 

 Concentrates 
 Smoking accessories and branded merchandise 

 Branded Apparel 
 
 We’re committed to making your experience easy, informative, and enjoyable, with no pressure, just helpful advice from a local team that knows cannabis.
 
 A Convenient Stop for Cape Cod Locals and Visitors 
 Conveniently located on Route 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza, Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary is an easy stop for anyone traveling to or from Provincetown, Eastham, Wellfleet, Truro, Orleans, Brewster, Hyannis or just off Cape in Plymouth. It’s a beautiful drive and…it’s worth the trip! Whether you’re exploring the Cape’s beaches, biking the Rail Trail, or heading back from a day at the National Seashore, our dispensary is a quick and convenient stop for all your cannabis needs.
 
 Why Cape Cod Cannabis? 
 Customers searching for a “dispensary near me” , “Cape Cod cannabis store” or “best dispensary on Cape Cod” consistently choose us for:
 
 The largest selection of quality cannabis products at the best prices on Cape Cod
 Trusted, lab-tested cannabis from top Massachusetts brands

 Transparent pricing and rotating promotions

 A clean, welcoming, and modern shopping experience

 Friendly and knowledgeable budtenders who offer personalized recommendations

 A true local feel with Cape Cod vibes

 
 Whether you’re seeking relaxation, creativity, relief, or just looking to try something new, we’ve got something for everyone, backed by customer-first service and deep local knowledge .
 
 Visit “what our customers say is” the Best Cannabis Dispensary on Cape Cod 
 Cape Cod Cannabis is more than a Wellfleet dispensary…we’re a destination. Locals and visitors alike rely on us for quality cannabis, honest guidance, and a smooth shopping experience. Stop by today and see why we’re consistently rated as the best dispensary in Wellfleet, MA , and one of the top cannabis spots on Cape Cod.
 
 Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary…Always worth the trip! 

 

 
 
 
 CLICK TO VIEW FAQ'S
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Are the Cape Cod Cannabis educational rack cards free?
 
 
 
 
 Yes. Cape Cod Cannabis provides educational rack cards to participating Cape Cod businesses and hospitality establishments at no cost, subject to availability and program eligibility.

 
 
 
 What information is included on the rack cards?
 
 
 
 
 The Cape Cod Cannabis educational rack cards provide adults 21+ with helpful cannabis and CBD information, responsible-use guidance, and information about Cape Cod Cannabis in Wellfleet. The materials are designed to be easy to read and useful for residents, visitors, and guests who want to learn more before visiting a recreational dispensary.

 
 
 
 Where can businesses display the rack cards?
 
 
 
 
 Participating businesses can display the rack cards in appropriate areas where adult guests and visitors can access local information, such as information racks, concierge areas, guest areas and other suitable locations.

 
 
 
 Does Cape Cod Cannabis deliver the rack cards?
 
 
 
 
 Yes. Cape Cod Cannabis coordinates complimentary delivery directly to participating Cape Cod businesses. Additional rack cards may also be available when needed, based on availability.

 

 

 
 
 
 Intro to Cannabis 101 
 
 

 Your Local One-Stop Shop on Cape Cod.
Trusted by Cape Codders and visitors since 2021. 
 Easy to find and convenient to visit, Cape Cod Cannabis is located on Route 6 in the South Wellfleet Shopping Plaza , making us an easy stop for anyone looking for a recreational cannabis dispensary on Cape Cod . Whether you’re coming from Eastham, Truro, Provincetown, Orleans, Brewster, Yarmouth, Plymouth, or exploring Cape Cod on vacation, our convenient Route 6 location offers ample free parking and a streamlined check-in process for a smooth, welcoming, and stress-free dispensary experience.
 
 900+ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ Google Reviews 
 4.9 ⭐ Rating / 5.0 
 
 Over time, we’ve built a reputation for delivering an experience that blends outstanding quality with warm, personalized service. Our goal is to be the place people think of first when they’re looking for trusted products on the Outer Cape.

 
 

 Always worth the trip!

 Green Wednesday 2025: Cape Cod Cannabis 
 
 What Is Green Wednesday? 
 Green Wednesday is the cannabis industry’s own shopping holiday, landing the day before Thanksgiving each year. This is when dispensaries roll out unbeatable cannabis deals and customers across the country search dispensary near me to stock up before the festivities begin.
 
 Whether you’re planning a relaxed night in, prepping for family time, or getting ready for the legendary pre-Thanksgiving walk , Green Wednesday 2025 is the perfect time to explore new strains, try premium flower, or grab that top-shelf concentrate you’ve been eyeing.
 
 The Rise of Green Wednesday 
 Since the early days of legalization, cannabis retailers have seen massive sales spikes on the Wednesday before Thanksgiving. Around 2016, dispensaries began offering Green Wednesday specials, and the trend exploded.
 
 Now, it’s the second busiest cannabis shopping day of the year , only surpassed by 4/20. From new customers to seasoned consumers, everyone’s looking for cannabis dispensary deals near me and local shops are delivering.
 
 Why Green Wednesday 2025 Is the Perfect Time to Stock Up 
 With deals across all product categories , this is your opportunity to explore everything the modern cannabis market has to offer:
 
 Top-shelf flower & Pre-Rolls — premium strains at doorbuster prices
 Concentrates & Vapes — discreet, potent, and portable
 Edibles & Beverages — perfect for family gatherings or relaxing evenings
 Tinctures & Oils — easy, precise dosing for higher-tolerance consumers
 Bundle Your Buzz – bundle your favorite products and save
 Shop Our Menu – shop our entire menu to find what’s right for you
 
 The deals are as diverse as the products, and Green Wednesday 2025 promises even more dispensary specials and loyalty rewards for shoppers searching weed deals near me. 
 
 Discreet Cannabis for the Holidays 
 Thanksgiving often means spending time with family, and not everyone is cannabis-friendly. Luckily, legalization has brought innovation that makes discreet consumption easier than ever.
 
 Infused beverages and water-soluble tinctures offer quick onset and subtle dosing.
 Single-serve drinks make for a low-key, social way to enjoy cannabis without smoke or odor.
 Edibles infused with cannabinoids like CBG can promote calm, while THCv offers an energetic boost for lively conversation.
 
 Whether you’re hosting dinner or joining family from out of town, these products make it easy to keep things chill and under the radar .
 
 Green Wednesday Savings Tips 
 The exclusive deals on Green Wednesday make it the perfect time to try something new :
 
 Splurge on a high-THC strain or boutique brand you’ve wanted to sample.
 Grab a few friends and enjoy a new infused joint .
 Opt for vaporizer cartridges for a clean, convenient, and discreet option when you’re on the go.
 
 As always, please consume responsibly. 
 
 Celebrate the Spirit of Green Wednesday 
 At its heart, Green Wednesday embodies gratitude for legal cannabis, community, and the plant itself. Whether you’re trying something new or stocking up on old favorites, it’s a chance to support your local Cape Cod Cannabis dispensary, share the love, and blaze responsibly before the big feast.
 
 So, this year, when you search dispensary near me or recreational cannabis deals near me , you’ll find more than great prices, you’ll find a celebration of the cannabis culture that connects us all at Cape Cod Cannabis, 1446 US-6, Wellfleet, MA .
 
 Address & Contact 
 Address: Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary, 1446 US-6, Wellfleet, MA 02667 

 Phone: (774) 383-3133

 Location: Located in the Route 6 shopping plaza in South Wellfleet

 
 Directions & Access 
 Cape Cod Cannabis is located right off Route 6 in South Wellfleet (in the old South Wellfleet General Store location), making it convenient if you’re coming from towns across Cape Cod

 Parking: We have 26 designated parking spaces plus several free municipal parking spots in the plaza

 Payment methods & note: We accept cash, debit cards, and CanPay. ATM on site (with small merchant fee for ATM/debit)

 High Anxiety

 
 
 
 
 
 April 8, 2024 
 
 

 Home / Cannabis 101 / High Anxiety 
 

 High Anxiety 
 Potency across cannabis products has been on the rise, there aren’t many beginner friendly products on the market today and it may be hard for a new smoker or people who are sensitive to cannabis to find a manageable high. Although I can’t give any medical advice, I’d like to share ways in which I am personally able to mitigate anxiety when going into a cannabis session. The best way I have found to reduce anxiety in relation to the use of cannabis has been preparing my mind, body, and surroundings before taking in any THC.
 
 One of the biggest issues I run into when I get anxiety from cannabis is from procrastinating a task, smoking before doing what needs to be done in the day. If there are essentials that need doing such as chores, food prep or assignments of some sort it is always best to finish these tasks before beginning consumption. In my experience, getting high feels a whole lot better when you are actually able to relax and use cannabis to aid in that relaxation rather than to escape your responsibilities.
 
 Speaking of being responsible, another major part of managing your high is making sure your body is prepared. I always make sure I am well hydrated and nourished for a more pleasant experience. If you are dehydrated and hungry it can occasionally lead to more negative side effects such as a headache or nausea which are the opposite effects of what we look for in a high. Not only should you prepare your body to get high but also your mind. Making sure you are in a good headspace for the experience is essential for the peak enjoyment of this plant. There are times where cannabis is nice to take the edge off of a stressful day but it should always be used in conjunction with other ways to destress and it should never be relied on as the sole way to manage emotions.
 
 My favorite way to use cannabis is to enhance whatever activity I am doing; with that being said, certain types of cannabis are better for certain activities. Choosing the right strain for the specific activity is very important in depicting what type of experience you will have. I try to stick with indica strains for things that are more relaxing like watching movies or sunbathing. When I am participating in activities where more attention is required such as doing a puzzle or playing some board games or video games I enjoy using a hybrid strain . For activities that require creativity, focus and concentration like playing a musical instrument, a physical activity or going out for a night of dancing I’ll choose a sativa strain . In the same way that we search for synergy between an activity and a high, you will also want the environment and the people around you to be that of a positive nature that will uplift your experience. If you are new to cannabis , I recommend consuming in a safe familiar place with close friends or family until you are comfortable with the effects. The people and the “vibe” around you shape your experience. A nice cozy room with a loved one is going to be a lot more enjoyable than a crowded noisy place for your first few sessions.
 
 Overall, take things slow and start with low doses, you can always take more but you can never take less. I recommend taking even just a single hit from a joint and waiting 15 minutes before consuming more to see how you feel. With these tips I hope you’re able to go into your sessions with more confidence and get the most out of each experience.
 
 – Mitch Arruda – Cape Cod Cannabis Product Specialist
